Do you mind if I come over to your place...?
Ever since junior high... I've never felt that you thought of me as a girl.
I want you to understand that, so...
Is it okay if I come over today?
I'll be busy with practice again after today... and once that happens, it feels like you'll make your choice.
You might be thinking, 'Wait,' or, 'I want some time to think it over on my own,' but...
The two of them, and probably me as well... I don't think we can wait.
I don't think we can just keep waiting in anxiety and like this.
I'll be waiting by the beach near your house... at the place where everyone used to hang out in junior high.
If you think that you might come to love me after all... if you decide to choose me... then meet me there.
If not, then I'll give up.

File.name: 05-5O-J05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You and Itou were talking about something on the way back, weren't you?
Oh, right. It was, you know, that thing you were concerned about before.
You mean the thing with Sekai?
Well, there's Saionji, but Katsura-san's involved, too. I know them both, so I guess you could say I was kind of curious.
Yeah, we used to go to the pool and stuff. And the girls were both after Itou, so I just ended up looking like an idiot.
I-it's not like that! This was before I started dating you, and besides, Katsura-san doesn't mean anything to me anymore!
Mmn... but she's so pretty, and she's got an incredible body, too.
Yeah, those breasts are incredible, aren't they? She really floored me at the pool.
So you were cheating on me after all!
N-no! You're my number one! I'd never look at another girl!
Still, I wonder how Itou's doing? Has he gone to visit Sekai?
He was totally like, 'Saionji's waiting for me!' before he dashed off, wasn't he?
Well, whichever girl he chooses... it'll be the one he really loves, so there's no point in us worrying about it.

File.name: 05-5O-K00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Are you always here at around this time?
No... I stayed up late last night, so I overslept a little.
I see... so, you're normally on the train before this one?
No, I'd say about two trains earlier.
I see... maybe I should start getting up a little earlier, then.
Because I want to be on the same train as you.
I told you yesterday, didn't I? About how I felt?
That's why I'm not going to hide it any longer. If it bothers you, then just tell me.

File.name: 05-5O-K02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well, I'll just take this train like I normally do, then.
After all, it's the one I usually catch.

File.name: 05-5O-L00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Take a seat, Makoto. I made lunch for us.

File.name: 05-5O-L02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What happened with Katsura-san, I mean.
I didn't want to hand you over to her, no matter what.
Ah! Hey, are you free to come over to my place today?
It's a little early, but I bought that coat that I mentioned earlier.
I wanted you to be the first to see it.
What do you want to do?
From: Katsura Kotonoha | Sub: After class...\nI'd like to see you after class. May I come to your house? I'll be waiting downstairs.
I'll be waiting at my place, okay?

File.name: 05-5O-L03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...She said that she'd be coming over today.
There won't be anyone home today, so...
Please... don't go over to Katsura-san.

File.name: 05-5O-L04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'll be waiting for you, okay?!
What, were you thinking of skipping out on us?
Uguh... I just forgot about it, that's all.
My parents have the day off from the store today, so they said they'd like to have tea with us!
Geh... I'm not really good with stuff like that.
Hey, just kidding! Let's go have some tea together!
Yeah! Makoto, aren't you going home?
Yeah... I'm just thinking about some stuff.
Well, given the show you put on at lunchtime... you've basically got everyone's attention.
It's probably not my place to say something like this, but... why don't you just do what feels right to you?
Although seeing that kind of scene every day sure would make for some interesting conversation topics in class.
I have to settle this once and for all.
So for now, I'm going to think it over a little more.
Right... well, give it your best.
Yeah, thanks. Sorry to worry you like that.

File.name: 05-5O-M00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: She's always been there beside me.
I never noticed when we were fooling around together... but the person I really wanted was always there, right beside me.
I've thought about how those times were the most fun I've ever had in my life...
But it was all because Katou was with me.
It was so obvious, and yet, I never noticed. I drifted around, hanging with other girls, being pushed this way and that...
And now, for me to just accept Katou's confession like I'm tired of everything and running away from it all...
Do I have any right to do that?
Maybe not, but even if I don't...
I love her more than anyone else.
The girl I love the most... it's you after all, isn't it?
I'd always thought of us as close friends... but the truth is, maybe I saw you not only as a friend, but as a girl, too.
Katou... will you go out with me?

File.name: 05-5O-N00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Um... I'm going to Makoto-kun's house.
I told him... that I'd be coming over today.
Because Itou's going to see Sekai.
He's not going to hang out with someone like you!
Is it true that Makoto-kun is... going to see Saionji-san?
Well, Saionji sort of just told him to come, so I don't know whether he's actually going.
Still, he looked like he was really struggling to decide... I just don't know.
If you've made plans with him, then I guess he probably won't go and see Saionji, but...
Did you really make plans with him?
I... only told him that I would be coming. I'm not sure how he'll respond...
If he really loves you... then he'll come for sure.
But if he doesn't, would you please just give up on him?
I want you to respect the decision that he's working so hard to reach.
Well, we'll be going now... I'll be hoping that he chooses you.

File.name: 05-9H-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: When it comes to summer, nothing compares to this.
Even these seeds are great in their own...
I keep telling you not to keep your girlfriend waiting. She's going to be here any second, you know.
Yeah, yeah. Guess I'll leave now, then... hmn?
Oh, it's just this air mail letter.
Yes, it came for you this morning. Pretty unusual, right?
Hmm... Mom, you can read English, can't you?
It's French, but it seems to be addressed to you. Why don't you try opening it?
Hmn? Oh, now you've gotten the table all wet. Who's the letter from?
Oh, look, she's here. You'd better go, or she's going to be upset with you again.

File.name: 05-9H-A01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hello, Sekai-chan. Oh, who's that girl with you?
Oh, right. This is Setsuna. We've been friends since...

File.name: 05-9H-A02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hello, Kotonoha-san. Oh, who's that girl with you?
Oh, right. This is Makoto-kun's former classmate, Kioura Setsu...

File.name: 05-9K-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Uuh...! S-speaking of which, are things going to be okay for you?
Won't your family be worried about you?
Well... I don't mind, because something wonderful has happened.
You've... finally become my real boyfriend.
That's why I'm not worried about my family.
But if things get out of hand, you'll get in trouble, right?
That call... it's from your house, isn't it?
Oh, sheesh. It's not that button.
Ah. In that case, you mustn't pick up.
What are you talking about? I've got to... she hung up.
It's not great at all. Why shouldn't I pick up if it's Kokoro-chan? I think she's worried about you.
She just figured out how to make video calls, and she's been dying to try it out. If she sees us like this, then...
Uwah... so that's how it is.
Still, even with video phones, you can just set them to voice-only, right?
In that case, we should still pick up.
I might be staying over at your place from now on, right? In that case, I think we need to reach an understanding with her.
Well... all right, if you say so.
Come on, we've got to pick up. Hello?
Ah! If you push that button...!
Uwah... I've really done it now!

File.name: 05-9O-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sheesh. I'm telling you, I'd never do that.
What are you talking about? You're always so fussy about every little thing.
Haah. She just keeps going and going, doesn't she?
Ever since they started going out after the festival... they've been arguing almost every day, haven't they?
It feels like it's getting worse every day, too...
What's the reason behind today's fight?
Sounds like something happened when they went to Sakakino-cho.
Eh? That was when they were with us, right?
It seems like something happened after we split up.
It was supposed to be a make-up date, too, but they ended up arguing on the way home.
I guess the make-up was a no-go, then.
If things get any worse, they might break up.
I'd feel bad for Otome, but if it actually came to that, then the four of us would be able to hang out together again.
I think those two are getting along just fine.
Really? But things look so bad between them.
...They're secretly sneaking in kisses behind our backs. I took a photo.
I guess they're still crazy about each other, then.
I don't know what Otome sees in Itou... but I guess they'll naturally end up fighting sometimes since she's so outspoken.
And you said they'd definitely break up.
Uh-huh. But if they're really that close, then they'll just end up getting back together again...
You just can't tell, can you?

File.name: 05-9S-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Come on! You need to look this way, too.
Yes, again. We're going to take lots and lots of photos and leave lots and lots of memories.

File.name: 05-A0-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...It's your fault that she's been acting strange, isn't it?

File.name: 05-A0-H02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Are you just going to keep playing dumb?
Just now... when Sekai was crying, I could hear her whispering your name.

File.name: 05-A0-H03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: That's an answer in itself, isn't it?

File.name: 05-A0-H04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Unlike Hikari, I didn't mind that you were going out with Sekai.
I knew that she's liked you ever since the entrance ceremony,
and she always looked so happy when she talked about you.
But then... you started eating with her and going out together... and just look at what happened!
Ever since she started going out with you, she's looked gloomy all the time!
You're her boyfriend, aren't you? Didn't you start going out with her because you love her?
You do love her, don't you?
If you do, then why aren't you making her happy?!
Why don't you let her keep smiling?!
She cries all the time, now! I don't want to see her like that, you know! I'll never recognize you as her boyfriend
If you hurt her any more... I won't forgive you.

File.name: 05-A2-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I couldn't resist being tempted by Kotonoha... and because of that, I ended up hurting Sekai...
Even though she's loved only me this whole time... I've hurt her so very, very deeply...
...and so, at the very least, I have to tell her that I do.
That I won't be swayed by Kotonoha anymore.

File.name: 05-A2-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sekai... what are you doing here...?
"From: Setsuna | Title: Re:"\n"Don't come back! I've sent Itou your way."\nMakoto: Kioura...
I...! I'm sorry... I get swayed so easily... but I love you, and that's the truth...!
I won't be tempted by Kotonoha anymore. I love you... and only you...
I know I've done all sorts of unforgivable things, but... but I love you! So...

File.name: 05-A2-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Still, how did Kioura know that I'd be going to your house...?
She said that she overheard you by the shoe rack.
Ah, she must have been nearby when I was talking to Katou. I didn't notice her at all.
Are you sure you weren't just so engrossed in talking to Katou-san that you didn't even notice her?
It wasn't like that, you idiot.
Hey, it's not like that between me and Katou. We're just old friends. I'll introduce you to her next time.
Don't start getting any weird suspicions. I told you how I really feel just now, didn't I?
I know... but Katou-san said that she wanted to go out with you, didn't she?
No, it's not. Setsuna heard it loud and clear.
Hey, look. It's true that she said she'd go out with me if you rejected me, but...
That's just one of her usual jokes. She's always been saying stuff like that since junior high.
So don't let it bother you, okay...?
Come on, let's hurry up and go inside.
...Sorry about my mom being home today. She'll be coming back after her night shift.
That's okay. We shouldn't be bothering her now, anyway. My mom just happens to be out today, so... no one's home.

File.name: 05-A2-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Eheheh... your mother said it was all right for me to wait inside.
She and I have come to get along quite well, you know.
She said that I'd make a good wife, too, so...
Sekai... forgave me... as weak and quick to waver as I've always been...
I... just can't give you up!
For you, I would do anything... no matter what.
I know I've done something wrong to you, but...
I love Makoto... and that's why I won't hesitate anymore.
I... can't go on living without him... and yet, you're still going to take him away from me?
I don't think the two of you can be happy together.
Because I'll always love you, Makoto-kun.

File.name: 05-A2-E00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I won't hesitate anymore... I've decided to look at you only, Sekai.
Y-yeah... but she said that she'd never give up...
It's okay. I'm sure she'll unders...

File.name: 05-A2-F00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's been... several months since that day.
I graduated without going to university, started helping out at Mom's hospital and ended up becoming a nurse.
From that day onward... Sekai and I drifted apart.
We, who were once so close...
Each time we met... each time we saw each other, we'd be reminded of how Kotonoha looked in her last moments...
It became too much for us, and so, we broke up...
And so, like this... we remember each other only during the anniversary of Kotonoha's death.
...Just as predicted by her final words.

File.name: 05-A2-Z00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sekai... what are you doing here...?
I...! I'm sorry... I get swayed so easily... but I love you, and that's the truth...!
I won't be tempted by Kotonoha anymore. I love you... and only you...
I know I've done all sorts of unforgivable things, but... but I love you! So...

File.name: 05-B0-A01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Where are you going at this time of night?
Why...? Because you've been acting weird lately.
I see... you're going on a date.
Keep it a secret from Mom, okay?
Sure, I won't say a thing.
Oh, that's where you've been going at night. I can relax now that I know you're just with your boyfriend. So... is he nice?

File.name: 05-B0-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: My, that's a clean desk you have there. It really suits you, Katsura-san.
So, I hear that you got dumped by Itou from 1-3. Isn't he, like, totally in love with that Saionji girl? Serves you right.
What are you talking about? Everyone knows that he and his new girlfriend are avoiding you.
He doesn't have a new girlfriend. After all...

File.name: 05-B0-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You're here to see Makoto, aren't you?
He isn't home yet... oh, I know. Would you like to wait inside?
It's cold outside, isn't it? It's almost December, you know.
I think he'll be home soon, but I'm on the night shift tonight, so I have to leave soon.
Okay, then... I'll leave Makoto to you.
I wonder if that's his room in the back...
Don't stare too much. I know it's cramped.
That's not true. It's bigger than mine.
Really? I think yours is bigger.
It looks big, but it's actually pretty small.
Really...? Oh, do you want some tea?
I love your kisses... they make me feel tingly deep down inside...
No, let's go to the bed. Remember how you panicked when Mom came back for something the other day and almost caught us?
I thought I'd finally get to introduce you to her, and you had to go and hide.
Well... it's not as if I could have said 'hi' without any clothes on.
Haha... so, what'll it be today? With or without clothes?
I want you... to take them off.
Sheesh... you're getting more and more perverted.
As if you're not enjoying it.

File.name: 05-B0-D02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So... we can do it all day long.
No way... you still want to do it? It's already morning.
When I smell your scent... I can't help myself.

File.name: 05-B0-D03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Breasts actually float in hot water.
Stop staring at them... it's embarrassing...
But not as embarrassing as this position, right?
Come on, try putting it in by yourself.

File.name: 05-B0-D04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Wait... aren't you being too loud...? They're going to hear us... next door...
Not as loud as your voice.
No... that one was... your fault... mnn...!
Haah...! No... if you do that, I'll... I'll... haah... ahh... ahhh...!
No... ah... ahh... aah.... haah... ahhnn!
I can't wait anymore... put it in... ahh!

File.name: 05-B0-D05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm... coming again... I'm going to come...!
Haah... let's come... together... squirt it all out... your hot...
Haah... I... I'm coming... uuh...! Ahah... ah... aaaah!
Aha... ahaha... kuh...! Uwahh...! Haha...! Ahahaha...!
I thought I saw something move on the balcony...
Is it just my imagination...? Hmn?
What's this...? It's wet over here.

File.name: 05-B0-F00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Eheheh... nice day today, isn't it?
Is it really just the weather that's making you so cheerful?
Heheh... well, you can say whatever you like!
Long time no see, Katsura-san. What's...

File.name: 05-G0-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So, she's already gone that far... just as I'd expected from her.
...I don't have a chance against her, do I?
I got angry and said all those things at lunch, but I can't change the fact that Makoto-kun likes Saionji-san now.
Haah... I've got to try harder...

File.name: 05-G0-A02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What's onee-chan doing in the kitchen?
She says she's making lunch for tomorrow.
Are you sure she doesn't need your help?
She said she didn't need it. She's going to make it all on her own.
Aww... you've gotten on her bad side.
You're right. She won't tell me a thing about her boyfriend, and even though I tell her to bring him over, she...
...Is she really going to be okay?

File.name: 05-G0-A03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: She's at it again today, isn't she?
Maybe things went well after all.
You mean with Makoto-kun, right? I wish he'd come over to play again.
So do I! If it looks like he's about to come over, be sure to let me know!
Don't give up! Let's hope for the best.

File.name: 05-G0-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Eheheh... nice day today, isn't it?
Is it really just the weather that's making you so cheerful?
Things are going well with Itou, aren't they?
I still don't know... it feels like we're getting back to the way we were before,
but we're still a long way away from eating lunch together like we used to...
Well, you just leave the enemies on the outside to us.
Quick, nothing. Yamamoto said he didn't know what you were talking about.
Stop screwing around with me. I looked like a real idiot, you know.
Oh, calm down. Here, I'll give you a few meal tickets.
Eh...?! Okay, but are you sure?
Take them. It's my way of apologizing.
Somehow, I get the feeling that I'm being bought off... but thanks.
Don't mention it. I'll give you one for spaghetti and one for meal set A.
Don't worry about it. I'm giving you two, so go and eat with Sekai or something.
Yeah, that's right. You should go too, Sekai.
Nanami's treat, huh...? Maybe I will, then.

File.name: 05-G0-B01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: And now, we come to graphs of quadratic functions and coefficients...
Now, this is a basic problem which should serve as a review. Obuchi, read this part out loud.
Given the following graph for the quadratic function\nax2 + bx + c, solve for a, b, c, b2-4ac...
Very good. Now, what do we do with the graph in (1)?
Okay, I'll take care of it.
Oh dear. Did it get caught on something?
Katsura-san, would you mind not making a mess in class?
This was your fault, you know. Be sure to clean up the floor so it's nice and spotless, okay?
She just doesn't learn, does she? You've let everyone in the girls' basketball club know too, right?
Yeah. They all said they'd help.
That idiot. And after we told her to leave Itou alone, too.

File.name: 05-G0-B02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: There are still breadcrumbs on the edge of the floor.
I'm sorry! I'll clean them up right away.

File.name: 05-G0-B03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: If you do anything more to Kotonoha, I'm going to get angry.
Don't play dumb. You've been urging the girls from the sports clubs and class 4 to pick on her, haven't you?

File.name: 05-G0-B04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Katsura... haven't you learned your lesson yet?
What are you planning on doing with that lunch?
Don't expect any mercy from us just because it's smaller than yesterday's.
You're the one who needs to stop!
This is a class matter. It's none of your business, so get lost.
What are you talking about? You're in class 3.
That's why I can't just stand by and watch her about to get hit.
Are you in on this bullying, too?
You're just going along with your club, right?
Can you please make them stop?
I know you can do it. You're in the girls' basketball club with Kanroji, after all.
I guess I might be able to...
The rest of you had better leave her alone from now on, too.

File.name: 05-G0-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah, it looks like Mom's back. I'll call again later. Huh? Yeah, okay. All right. Good night.
It's not one of your junior high friends.
Ufufu... that's a cute girlfriend you have there. I was quite surprised.

File.name: 05-G0-D01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Eh...?! But she told me that she was.
She's just... someone who hangs around and bothers me.
That's not how she seemed to me...
I'm sorry, Makoto is just so...
What a thing to do to such a pretty girl...
The truth is, Makoto-kun and I are quarrelling. I thought I could come and make up with him... but it can't be helped.
Haah... yes, you're right. Makoto is just...
Despite the way he acts, he's really not a bad boy. Please remain friends with him.
What a well-mannered child... unlike a certain Makoto.

File.name: 05-G0-D02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You'll introduce her to me, won't you?

File.name: 05-G0-D03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Why are you freezing up? Is it that shocking to have your mother find out about her?
Go on, she's in the living room.
Oh, she'll be leaving soon, so I'll walk her back.
It's okay to take it easy, you know... although I suppose her parents might be worried about her coming back late.

File.name: 05-G0-D05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry... I'm just so happy...
I was afraid... because I couldn't get through to you.
Hey, you're heading home now, right?
That's why I'll walk you. It's dangerous out there at night.

File.name: 05-G0-D06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm so sorry. I came all the way to your door...
but I was just thinking about turning back when I ran into your mother, and...
Haah... that sounds like her, all right.
You're going home, right? I'll walk you.

File.name: 05-G0-D07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry... I was thinking of going home, but then I ran into your mother, so...
Still, I'm glad you decided to see me.
You blocked my number, so I thought that maybe you didn't want to see me anymore.
I know. You decided to meet with me, after all.
You're going home, right? I'll walk you.
What choice do I have? Come on, let's go.

File.name: 05-G0-E00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's the first time we've taken this route by ourselves, isn't it?
Nishi-harami and Haramihama are right next to each other, but they feel surprisingly far apart, don't they?
Well, they are a whole station apart.
Yes... perhaps we even passed each other by as children.
I used to spend all my free time studying the arts instead of playing, so I'd always look forward to festivals.
Yes, I'd be thinking about how I didn't have to go to practice that day.
Piano, ballet, dance, calligraphy... all sorts of things.
But you don't practice them anymore?
My mother told me to keep them up through junior high, but I made her promise to let me stop if I got into the academy.
And so you did... kind of feels like a waste, though.
Because once I did... I was able to meet you.
Throughout junior high, I'd think of nothing but practice,
and even though my friends would invite me out, I was... less than sociable.
So when Saionji-san invited me out, I might not have accepted. When I think of it like that, I'm glad I stopped.
About the way things ended up.
Ended up...? I don't think it's over just yet.
No, it's not. We're just having a quarrel, aren't we? I'd... like to make up with you.
...It doesn't have to be right away. Even if it's just little by little...
I wouldn't mind starting all over again as friends... and giving it one more try...
If you don't hate me, that is... even if it's just as acquaintances...
I never did, to begin with... I just got angry and said some awful things.
...Shall we start from there and give it another try?

File.name: 05-G0-E01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'll be fine from here onwards.
Starting from tomorrow, we'll be friends.

File.name: 05-G0-F02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Excuse us for just a second!
Ah... oh, it's just you, Kanroji.
You usually don't say a word to me when you see me on the train.
That's all in the past now. Let's try this again. Good morning.
Say, don't you feel kind of bored on the way to school? Wouldn't it be nice to have someone to talk to?
Kuroda's standing right over there, isn't she? Go talk to her.
Oh, naturally. She'll talk too, right?

File.name: 05-G0-F03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: S-so, were you watching TV yesterday?

File.name: 05-G0-F05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: The show that's like 'From the Train Window of Space'.
The one with the grand music that shows the earth and the stars from different angles every month?
That thing puts you to sleep in three seconds flat.
No way, it's totally interesting. Right, Hikari?
Why do I have to talk to someone like Itou...?
So... what did you do last night?

SetSELECT.sel2: 'I spoke with Sekai on the phone'

File.name: 05-G0-F06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well, Kotonoha came over, and that's about it...
So, she comes over to play at night.

File.name: 05-G0-F07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I spoke with Sekai on the phone.
Don't think that I approve of you and Sekai being... gwah!
I-it's nothing, don't worry about it.
But... not even boxers usually deliver that kind of punch to the guts.
S-so, I see. You and Sekai talk on the phone at night. Hahaha, you two sure are close.
So, are you just going to ignore Kuroda like that?

File.name: 05-G0-F08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Weren't you on the phone or anything?
Yeah, Sekai called, and we ended up talking for ages.... wait, how did you know that?
Hey, stop laughing and start taking care of Kuroda.

File.name: 05-G0-F09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah. It's just a pain to have her turn up at night like that.
Yeah, you're right. No one likes annoying girls like that, do they?

File.name: 05-G0-F10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Uwah! Hey! What are you turning all red for?!

File.name: 05-G0-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yamamoto said to come to the staff room right now.
Liar. I haven't done anything lately to earn a lecture from him.
Besides, when did you hear that, anyway?
Yamamoto supervises the tennis club after class. He's got nothing to do with girls' basketball!
I-I ran into him on the way home.
You'll find out once you go, right?
Itou's already got a girlfriend called Saionji Sekai. All you're doing by hanging around is bothering him!
Yeah. I don't like to admit it, but they suit each other, and we're going to support them.
Consider yourself warned. Stay away from Itou.
Remember, you promised. Let's go, Hikari.

File.name: 05-G0-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: He said he was going to the cafeteria.

File.name: 05-G0-H02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Phew... that was kind of scary.
Haha... well, Katou and I know each other, so I figured it would be okay.
And... you called me your girlfriend.
No. I'd... like to be your girlfriend, too.
I'm... I'm sorry... I... I didn't... know...
I'm sorry! This was all my idea, and Sekai didn't know about any of it! So...!
Of course she didn't! That kind of thing is...

File.name: 05-G0-I01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: She's with the girls' basketball club. You know, for that thing.
They're doing this for Kanroji-san from class 3, right?
You think Katsura was going out with him?
Maybe, but making a move on him was a mistake. He's some guy that Katsura-san's friend likes.
That girl from class 3... what's her name? Uh... oh, right. Saionji-san.
So, she's the one pulling the strings from the dark shadows.
Doesn't 'dark shadows' sound kind of weird?
Well, among us, Kanroji-san's basketball club and some of the other clubs, it looks like Katsura's in for a rough time.
But still, Otome and that guy from class 3... they're... you know... right?
Well, no wonder she's working so hard.
You got it. Did you see that expression on Katsura's face?
Yeah, yeah. She was totally tearing up. What a classic.
Who the hell brings a big lunchbox like that to school?
That was an awesome kick, Kumi.
It was fine when I caught my leg on it, right? But it totally went flying when Kumi kicked it.
It wouldn't have gone that well without the help from your foot.
You might just make it to the J-league!

File.name: 05-G0-J02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Are you on your way home?

File.name: 05-G0-J03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ufufu... you'll find out soon enough.

File.name: 05-G0-K00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Eh? Today? I have a school lunch...
I mean tomorrow... would you like to have lunch together?

File.name: 05-G0-K01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It'd be nice to be able to enjoy lunch on the roof again, just like back when we first met.

File.name: 05-G0-K02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...I've made plans to have lunch with Sekai tomorrow.
There's someone who's more important to me than my friends... please understand.

File.name: 05-G0-K03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sorry, would you mind leaving us alone for a second?
I want to speak with Kotonoha.

File.name: 05-G0-L00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Um... I made some lunch... but... I-I'm so clumsy... I tripped and dropped it...
And now, all I have left... is tea...
It's okay. Come on, let's buy something.
Look, I'll go, then. How's bread...? Well, I guess there's not much choice at this hour.

File.name: 05-G0-L01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I was... really looking forward to this lunch...
Yeah, looks like we missed out this time.
I'm sorry... this is all my fault...
I'll bring lunch too, so we can trade.

File.name: 05-G0-L03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...Are you sure you're okay with this?
All I've done up until now is hurt you... but from now on, I'm going to protect you.

File.name: 05-KA-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry, did I wake you?
Fufu... you look sleepy. What shall we have for breakfast?
No... we'll be late for school... ahhn...!

File.name: 05-KA-A01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: That girl isn't here today, is she?
She seems like a nice girl, your girlfriend.

File.name: 05-KA-A02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: The truth is... there's this other girl I like, but... somehow, this is how it ended up.
Well, I don't know the details... but you should think hard about it and come up with your own answer.
Aww... and I would have loved to have that girl call me 'Mom', too.
Ahahah, I won't say anything more. Give it your best.

File.name: 05-KA-A03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: She's doing all this... for someone like me.
Yes, you ought to be grateful.

File.name: 05-KA-A04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well? Are you going to boast? Complain? I'll listen to either.
I guess boys have their secrets too...
Well, I say keep thinking about it, think long and hard, and don't stop until you find an answer that satisfies you.
Oh! And don't let her give birth at our hospital. I can't recommend it. Use Oohara Central or St. Pregnan's instead.
T-that's not the sort of thing I'm worried about!
I see... but make sure you use protection, okay?
You can't hide anything from me. I'm the one who washes your sheets.
Ahahah... and just like that, he confesses...

File.name: 05-KA-A05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Why not? Before... you used to love me so much.
Makoto-kun... you love my body, don't you?
I was in such a panic the other day, when I changed into my gym clothes and realized your kiss marks were showing... hehe.
You love me enough to give me all those kiss marks... so why...?
I don't mind doing things like this, you know.
It's hard to believe how afraid I was before... right now, each day, I feel like... I want to be in your arms.
Just look... at what your smell alone does to me...
Look at how wet it makes me.
It was you who did this... who made me like this...
Telling me... that you love me too, right here.
We're so compatible with each other... both our hearts... and our bodies...
Please, do it with me... the way you always do.

File.name: 05-KA-A06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It seems that you're tired... so I'll go home for today.
But in return, let's have lunch together tomorrow.

File.name: 05-KA-A07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'll do it all on my own today...
It feels like it's going to go straight into my womb...
If you come inside me like this, I'll get pregnant for sure...
I'll start moving, so you can just lie right there.
And you were resisting so much at first, too...
Shall we have lunch together tomorrow?
You can have your lunch... and then after that, I'd like you to have me.

File.name: 05-KA-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hey. You skipped school the whole day before yesterday, and now you're late again today?
What? What are you doing, staying up late anyway...? Don't tell me that you...?
You've gotten your hands on a nice video, right? Come on, lend it to me, too.
W-what?! You're the idiot! Idiot! Idiot!

File.name: 05-KA-B01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hey. I see you're late today.
Well, it's not as if first period's class was all that important.
Yeah, math with Nogi... everyone was sound asleep.

File.name: 05-KA-B02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Oh, Sekai. Want to eat together somewhere? I missed breakfast, so I'm kind of hungry...
There's something that I want to ask you.

File.name: 05-KA-B09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's depressing, but... if Kotonoha comes here...

File.name: 05-KA-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Where were you during the festival?
You couldn't make it to the bonfire, right?

File.name: 05-KA-C01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...sleeping. In class... I told you the other day on the phone, didn't I?
You were in class 3, sleeping with Katsura-san!

File.name: 05-KA-C02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: There was a bed in the back of class 3's haunted house... and you and Katsura-san were sleeping in it, weren't you?

File.name: 05-KA-C03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You can't tell me, can you?
After all... you were in class 3, sleeping with Katsura-san.
You don't need to hide it. I already know.

File.name: 05-KA-C04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Why did you sleep with Katsura-san?
Because now you love her more...?
If that's the case... you could have just said so.
I was so happy... when you chose me.
I thought that you liked Katsura-san...
but even so, I wanted there to be something between us, however small. Just being with you made me happy.
And then... you chose to sleep with me, and not Katsura-san... you told me that you loved me...
You were sleeping with Katsura-san behind my back.
Was I just a substitute for Katsura-san?
Was I just a replacement for her, while she was too afraid to sleep with you?
Am I not needed anymore, now that you can do it with her?
Or is it just my body that you still want?
I... must seem so stupid... so pathetic...
I felt so excited... so overjoyed when you held me, thinking,
'This person is my boyfriend'... I was so stupid...
I hate you... I hate you... I hate you so much. You... Katsura-san... everything... I hate it all...

File.name: 05-KA-C05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What is it? Why did you call me out onto the roof like this...?

File.name: 05-KA-C06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yes... that's what you told her.
To take care of Sekai... because she gets lonely...
That's why I need to be with her... right?
Because your heart isn't with her.

File.name: 05-KA-C09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Did you take advantage of her feelings to deceive her?
I didn't deceive her...! I... never meant to deceive her...

File.name: 05-KA-C10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...Look, this is between me and her.
If that's how you feel, then don't make her cry.
I won't forgive you if you do.
I heard that she's been stringing you along.
You are... I'm the one to blame.
Yeah... treading all over Sekai's feelings... clinging to Kotonoha's kindness...
causing both of them to suffer... all of it is my wretched fault.
That's all I wanted to say.
I'll make sure it doesn't happen.
I hope you act on those words.

File.name: 05-KA-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: When did you start stealing Makoto away from me?
You slept with him, didn't you? I know you did.
During the festival... someone made a secret video. When I pressed Makoto about it, he admitted it.
There was a camera somewhere, wasn't there?
...Yes, and because of it, I found out about what you've been doing.
I'll ask you one more time... when did it first start?
When did you start stealing Makoto...
I haven't stolen him from anyone.
Don't give me that! You slept with him!
I did, and not just during the festival, either... that much is exactly as you say.
But... the one who's been stealing him is you, isn't it?
On the roof... with my Makoto-kun.
You knew that Makoto-kun and I were going out.
Working to become the type of girl Makoto-kun likes... a girl who can please him, not a girl who's afraid to be touched.
That's why I won't lose to you anymore.
Blaming it on Makoto-kun like that... you're a terrible person.
I said that I would forgive everything and accept him, regardless of what you did to him...
and that's why he chose me.
No! I'm the one he chose!
Just because you gave him your body...? Because you took advantage of his loneliness...? That's just arrogance, isn't it?
I think you know as well as I do that it's true.
Even now... I'm sure you blame Makoto-kun, don't you?
Makoto-kun doesn't like girls like that.
...Stay away from him from now on, okay?

File.name: 05-KA-D01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: The third floor... in front of the second science room, huh...?

File.name: 05-KA-D02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Still... just where should I go?
Somewhere away from Kotonoha... I suppose.
What are you doing, walking down the corridor with a frown like that?
What is it? If you've got a problem, want to tell me about it?
Um... let's go and have lunch.
I'll wait, so... please, go ahead.
Why... are you going out with Katsura?
Yes, we are. Makoto-kun said that he loves me.
That was a long time ago...
Yesterday, the days before, and even during the festival...
Can't you see that you're bothering him?
...This has nothing to do with you.
This is between Makoto-kun and me.
That was... you just gave in to temptation.
No. I've loved her for a long time, now.
But there was a mix-up, and you and I ended up going out together.
It's my fault that Sekai misunderstood. I betrayed her in the worst way possible...
...And that's why she's not by your side anymore.
Then things are just fine the way they are, right?
I love you, Makoto-kun. I want to stay beside you.
If you're not going out with Saionji-san... then it's fine for you to go out with me, isn't it?
So that's why you've been harassing Saionji-san.
I was watching, you know. When you and she were arguing in the hallway.
You blamed her for what happened with Itou and made her cry, didn't you?
Saionji-san's not at school today, right? Isn't that because of what you did?
I'm... not going out with you anymore.
I got caught up in the moment and slept with you... but I think that was a mistake.
Let's put an end to this.
But... Saionji-san is already gone. She's not coming back, you know?
Even if I can't make up with Sekai... even if she won't forgive me... I won't choose you anymore.

File.name: 05-KA-F00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I heard that Katsura-san's been stringing you along.
The one who's really to blame... is me.
Taking advantage of Kotonoha's affection... betraying Sekai's feelings... all of it is my wretched fault.
That's all I wanted to say.

File.name: 05-KA-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's quite cold today, isn't it?
That's why, if I do this...
Ufufu... it's nice to see you looking troubled like that.

File.name: 05-KA-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sorry, I guess I just put you through some serious drama.
Thanks... to tell you the truth, I was still a little hesitant.
Kotonoha was coming on pretty strong... I knew that if I didn't reject her, she would just keep dragging me along forever.
But at the same time, a part of me thought that maybe it wouldn't be so bad.
At the festival, when I saw her sitting there all by herself with this sad look in her eyes, I wanted to protect her.
It was a mistake, wasn't it? Getting caught up in the mood like that... I really am a jerk.
But when I heard what you said to her, it's like I finally woke up... I realized that I loved Sekai after all.
So, the girl you liked was Saionji-san.
You know about Sekai? Oh, you have P.E. together, don't you?
She was with Nanami at the girls' basketball club's party.
And she's got a nice body, too.
And she's short, too. Unlike me...
It's not like you're particularly tall, though. You're only about my size.
They say that boys prefer smaller girls, right?
I don't think that's true. I could definitely go for someone about your height.
Haah... the way you make others feel special... I'll bet what just happened was because of that, too.
Well, anyhow... I'm grateful to you.
I guess it really does pay to have friends, huh?
Isn't it kind of a problem for you to just suddenly disappear?
Besides... right now, I don't want to go another moment without seeing her.
She probably won't forgive me... and maybe it's just for my own satisfaction, but...
If it doesn't work out, I'll be happy to go out with you... out of pity, that is.
Yeah, you've really cheered me up.
Well, I'll be going in, prepared for rejection.
Haah... what are the chances of him getting rejected, coming back and going out with me...
...It's not going to happen, is it?
Tsk. I really do love you, you know.

File.name: 05-KB-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Isn't it enough that I love him...?

File.name: 05-KB-A01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I wonder if she's on the phone with Makoto-kun...

File.name: 05-KB-A02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What's onee-chan doing in the kitchen?
She says she's making lunch for tomorrow.
Are you sure she doesn't need your help?
She said she didn't need it. She's going to make it all on her own.
Aww... you've gotten on her bad side.
You're right. She won't tell me a thing about her boyfriend, and even though I tell her to bring him over, she...
...Is she really going to be okay?

File.name: 05-KB-A03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: She's at it again today, isn't she?
Maybe things went well after all.
You mean with Makoto-kun, right? I wish he'd come over to play again.
So do I! If it looks like he's about to come over, be sure to let me know!
Don't give up! Let's hope for the best.

File.name: 05-KB-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: From: Katsura Kotonoha | Title: Sorry to bother you\nThere's something I want to talk to you about.\nI'll be waiting in the courtyard after class.

File.name: 05-KB-B01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Eheheh... nice day today, isn't it?
Is it really just the weather that's making you so cheerful?
Things are going well with Itou, aren't they?
I still don't know... it feels like we're getting back to the way we were before,
but we're still a long way away from eating lunch together like we used to...
Well, you just leave the enemies on the outside to us.
Quick, nothing. Yamamoto said he didn't know what you were talking about.
Stop screwing around with me. I looked like a real idiot, you know.
Oh, calm down. Here, I'll give you a few meal tickets.
Eh...?! Okay, but are you sure?
Take them. It's my way of apologizing.
Somehow, I get the feeling that I'm being bought off... but thanks.
Don't mention it. I'll give you one for spaghetti and one for meal set A.
Don't worry about it. I'm giving you two, so go and eat with Sekai or something.
Yeah, that's right. You should go too, Sekai.
Nanami's treat, huh...? Maybe I will, then.

File.name: 05-KB-B02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: And now, we come to graphs of quadratic functions and coefficients...
Now, this is a basic problem which should serve as a review. Obuchi, read this part out loud.
Given the following graph for the quadratic function\nax2 + bx + c, solve for a, b, c, b2-4ac...
Very good. Now, what do we do with the graph in (1)?
Okay, I'll take care of it.
Oh dear. Did it get caught on something?
Katsura-san, would you mind not making a mess in class?
This was your fault, you know. Be sure to clean up the floor so it's nice and spotless, okay?
She just doesn't learn, does she? You've let everyone in the girls' basketball club know too, right?
Yeah. They all said they'd help.
That idiot. And after we told her to leave Itou alone, too.

File.name: 05-KB-B03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: There are still breadcrumbs on the edge of the floor.
I'm sorry! I'll clean them up right away.

File.name: 05-KB-B04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: If you do anything more to Kotonoha, I'm going to get angry.
Don't play dumb. You've been urging the girls from the sports clubs and class 4 to pick on her, haven't you?

File.name: 05-KB-B05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Katsura... haven't you learned your lesson yet?
What are you planning on doing with that lunch?
Don't expect any mercy from us just because it's smaller than yesterday's.
You're the one who needs to stop!
This is a class matter. It's none of your business, so get lost.
What are you talking about? You're in class 3.
That's why I can't just stand by and watch her about to get hit.
Are you in on this bullying, too?
You're just going along with your club, right?
Can you please make them stop?
I know you can do it. You're in the girls' basketball club with Kanroji, after all.
I guess I might be able to...
The rest of you had better leave her alone from now on, too.

File.name: 05-KB-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What did you want to talk about?
Seducing...? What are you talking about?
He isn't the kind of person you think he is... the truth is, he's in love with me!
I'd always thought that there was nothing I could do, because you were the one he loved.
But... if he doesn't love you anymore... then I don't want to hold back.
Ever since I met Makoto at the entrance ceremony... I've been in love with him.
Makoto told me that he loves me, too... and yet, I lied to myself, telling myself I was doing it for you and for him.
I ignored how I really felt, unable to trust Makoto's feelings. I faltered... I was hurt, crying, lost...
That's why I'm not going to hide it anymore.
I'm not going to just give up anymore.
I'm not going to run away anymore.
I'm... not going to hesitate anymore.

File.name: 05-KB-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah, it looks like Mom's back. I'll call again later. Huh? Yeah, okay. All right. Good night.
It's not one of your junior high friends.
Ufufu... that's a cute girlfriend you have there. I was quite surprised.

File.name: 05-KB-D01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Eh...?! But she told me that she was.
She's just... someone who hangs around and bothers me.
That's not how she seemed to me...
I'm sorry, Makoto is just so...
What a thing to do to such a pretty girl...
The truth is, Makoto-kun and I are quarrelling. I thought I could come and make up with him... but it can't be helped.
Haah... yes, you're right. Makoto is just...
Despite the way he acts, he's really not a bad boy. Please remain friends with him.
What a well-mannered child... unlike a certain Makoto.

File.name: 05-KB-D02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You'll introduce her to me, won't you?

File.name: 05-KB-D03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Why are you freezing up? Is it that shocking to have your mother find out about her?
Go on, she's in the living room.
Oh, she'll be leaving soon, so I'll walk her back.
It's okay to take it easy, you know... although I suppose her parents might be worried about her coming back late.

File.name: 05-KB-D05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry... I'm just so happy...
Hey, you're heading home now, right?
That's why I'll walk you. It's dangerous out there at night.

File.name: 05-KB-D06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm so sorry. I came all the way to your door...
but I was just thinking about turning back when I ran into your mother, and...
Haah... that sounds like her, all right.
You're going home, right? I'll walk you.

File.name: 05-KB-D07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry... I was thinking of going home, but then I ran into your mother, so...
You're going home, right? I'll walk you.
What choice do I have? Come on, let's go.

File.name: 05-KB-E00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's been a while since we've walked together like this.
Ever since that time I went to your house before the festival, huh?
It feels like so long ago.
It hasn't been that long. Kokoro's been wanting to see you, you know.
She has so many lessons - cram school, piano, ballet, calligraphy - that keep her out all day... but she's still cheerful.
Haah... did you have to do all of those things, too?
Yes, although I stopped everything once I graduated from junior high.
My mother told me to keep them up through junior high, but I made her promise to let me stop if I got into the academy.
And so you did... kind of feels like a waste, though.
Because once I did... I was able to meet you.
Throughout junior high, I'd think of nothing but practice,
and even though my friends would invite me out, I was... less than sociable.
So when Saionji-san invited me out, I might not have accepted. When I think of it like that, I'm glad I stopped.
About the way things ended up.
Ended up...? I don't think it's over just yet.
No, it's not. We're just having a quarrel, aren't we? I'd... like to make up with you.
...It doesn't have to be right away. Even if it's just little by little...
I wouldn't mind starting all over again as friends... and giving it one more try...
If you don't hate me, that is... even if it's just as acquaintances...
I never did, to begin with... I just got angry and said some awful things.
...Shall we start from there and give it another try?

File.name: 05-KB-F02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Excuse us for just a second!
Ah... oh, it's just you, Kanroji.
You usually don't say a word to me when you see me on the train.
That's all in the past now. Let's try this again. Good morning.
Say, don't you feel kind of bored on the way to school? Wouldn't it be nice to have someone to talk to?
Kuroda's standing right over there, isn't she? Go talk to her.
Oh, naturally. She'll talk too, right?

File.name: 05-KB-F03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: S-so, were you watching TV yesterday?

File.name: 05-KB-F05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: The show that's like 'From the Train Window of Space'.
The one with the grand music that shows the earth and the stars from different angles every month?
That thing puts you to sleep in three seconds flat.
No way, it's totally interesting. Right, Hikari?
Why do I have to talk to someone like Itou...?
So... what did you do last night?

SetSELECT.sel2: 'I spoke with Sekai on the phone'

File.name: 05-KB-F06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well, Kotonoha came over, and that's about it...
So, she comes over to play at night.

File.name: 05-KB-F07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I spoke with Sekai on the phone.

File.PrintText: It's like... you're more irritable. You're not your usual self.
That's not true. You're usually much nicer.
I should get back to class, too...

File.name: 05-KF-F00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: He just kept on talking about Christmas. He looked so happy that I just couldn't...
I... tried to tell her, but...
Well, before I could, things got ugly and we ended up fighting.
No! I'm the one who totally failed.
I'll try harder... so you do the same.
Believe me. You're the only one that I love.

File.name: 05-KF-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I was going to call you when I got home.
I wanted to speak with you, too.
All right, you go first, then.
I wanted to apologize for lunchtime.
I said all sorts of things to frustrate you without even considering how you felt.
You were angry, and yet I ended up leaving first on my own. I'm so sorry.
I-it's fine. You don't need to apologize for that.
It was only natural for you to be angry. It was thoughtless of me to try and show you off as my boyfriend...
I said you don't need to apologize!
N-no, I'm happy that you've forgiven me.
U-um... so, what did you want to talk about...?

File.name: 05-KF-G01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I... don't think it's working between us.
U-um... are you really that angry about what happened?
I really am sorry. I won't ask you to eat in my classroom again.
And if you don't want to have lunch with me at all, I'll eat by myself, so...
You're... sorry? I... I don't understand. Why?
Am I doing something else to upset you?
If so, I'll stop! I'll change everything about myself that you don't like!
I... don't want to break up with you!

File.name: 05-KF-G02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Things like that happen all the time, don't they? Ufufu...

File.name: 05-KF-G03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Could it be that you've forgotten what you were going to say? Ufufu...
Things like that happen all the time, don't they?

File.name: 05-KF-G04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah... a j-joke? Oh, gosh, I was...
Ooh... you almost made me cry!
You mustn't joke about things like that.
I can't even imagine breaking up with you.
If you were to dump me, I'd just die.
That's how much I love you.
Yes, of course. I know you do.

File.name: 05-KF-G05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Do you... not like me anymore?

File.name: 05-KF-G06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: If you don't... I'm going to cry.

File.name: 05-KF-G07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I don't need a reason to stop liking someone.
That can't be it! We were doing just fine until today, weren't we?
Look... I'm just not going to see you anymore.

File.name: 05-KF-G08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Please, tell me! Why do you want to break up?
We have to break up... we have to!

File.name: 05-KF-G10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I... don't want to break up with you...

File.name: 05-KF-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I thought about it, but he would have been shocked to hear that I was going out with you.
He looked so surprised just hearing that we were breaking up. I didn't think I could rub salt into the wound.
Do you think I should have told him?

File.name: 05-KF-H01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: He asked me who you liked...
I think of him as my friend. I just couldn't hide it from him.
But when I told him, he got really upset. I guess it's pretty much over between us.
No, I told him because I wanted to.

File.name: 05-KF-H02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm not sure. Maybe it would have been better to tell him.
He asked me who you liked... but I couldn't answer.
I guess you must have felt the same way.
I think so. I felt awful just watching him.
Me too. It was tough just listening to his voice.
But we're doing the right thing, right?
Two people who love each other should be together.

File.name: 05-KF-H04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: But... she said she didn't want to break up. I told her we were breaking up anyway, but...
That's what I'd expect her to say.
Still, I don't think she's really accepted it.

File.name: 05-KF-H05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I didn't do a good job of explaining, so I'm not sure she's really accepted it.
W-well... she might be under the impression that I was joking.
Ah... yeah, Katsura-san is sort of like that. I'll bet she could never imagine you not liking her.

File.name: 05-KF-H06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: But you're definitely the one I love.

File.name: 05-KF-J00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry to call you out at lunchtime.
There's something I wanted to talk to you about.
You and Makoto-kun are close friends, aren't you?
And you sit next to each other in class, right? So you see him all the time.
That's why you're the only one who can answer my question.
Yesterday, Makoto-kun said he wanted to break up.
Of course, he was just joking. It's not as though I took it seriously!
But... since yesterday, he's been acting strange. It's concerning.
I... I was wondering if there was someone trying to seduce him.
Yes. Even in my class, he's been marked by several people.
There are two or three girls who say they like him.
There might be even more in the other classes. Are there any in your class?
I was thinking that maybe one of those girls was trying to seduce him.
I can't afford to lose to them, so I spent all of yesterday thinking as hard as I could...
And so... I've decided to invite him out on Christmas Eve.
Well, it's a special night, isn't it?
I'm going to try inviting him to go out with me that day.
I'd like to think that he will. That's why I've even booked a hotel.
B-but... are there any hotels which still have rooms available?
I'll use my father's connections. He has some influence with the one at Sakakino Hills.
So, I've decided to just wait at the hotel.
He may not come, you know.
A small part of me feels the same way.
Just maybe... Makoto-kun is already in love with someone else... and before I know it, I'll be left all alone.
It's always been like that. I never had any friends before. I was always the one being bullied... always the one on my own.
But then I met Makoto-kun, and for the first time...
He's taught me just how wonderful it is not to be alone.
When I'm with him... I don't just feel excited. I get this warm, happy feeling...
If Makoto-kun didn't like me anymore, I'd go back to that sense of loneliness again... no, something even worse.
Now that I know how much fun being with someone can be, I'm sure it would be even more painful to go back to being alone.
It would be so painful... I'm sure I would just die.
Makoto-kun is as important to me as my own life.
If he didn't like me anymore... then there'd be no point in continuing to live.
I'm going to wait at the hotel and send him a message. I'll tell him that if he doesn't come, I'm going to die.
But... if I do, Makoto-kun will...
He'll come. If you tell him that, he'll come for sure!
Katsura-san... you really are naive. You won't understand unless I tell you, will you?
The reason Makoto said he wanted to break up is because he's going out with someone else.
Because... the person he's going out with... is me...
Oh, come on... what are you talking about? You're the one who introduced him to me. You can't possibly be...
All this time... I've been in love with him...
But he was in love with you... so I told him I'd help him go out with you, and we ended up becoming close friends...
But... I couldn't change the way I felt. My feelings just grew stronger and stronger, until I couldn't hold back anymore.
Why?! Sawanaga-san was really in love with you, you know!
He looked so happy when he was preparing a Christmas present for you...
...I'm sorry, but I can't stop now.
Then... were you the one who seduced Makoto-kun?
I haven't given up on him.
I'm going to send him that message.
I'm not going to hand him over, either.
Let's have Makoto-kun decide. The one he chooses to spend Christmas Eve with... will be the girlfriend he wants.

File.name: 05-KF-K00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Don't see you here often. Are you by yourself?
It's finally Christmas Eve, but you don't look like you've got any plans.
...Hey, some friends and I are going to karaoke today. Do you want to come along?
You might feel better after belting out a few songs.
I guess I'm looking kind of down, huh?
Yeah, I was a little conflicted about something... but I'm fine now.
Thanks for the invitation, but I can't make it today.
I guess you could call her that.
I'm going to see her... and make her my real girlfriend.

File.name: 05-KF-L00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Please... turn off the lights. This is embarrassing...

File.name: 05-KG-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah, Katsura-san! It's a pleasure to get a call from you. What's up?
...I can't give up on the person that I really love.
That's why I can't keep going out with you anymore.
W-what are you talking about? I... I don't get it... uh...?

File.name: 05-KG-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's a lovely day today, isn't it?
Still, it's a little depressing to have such nice weather on a Monday, isn't it? It just makes you want to go out and play!
It's just that you don't seem your usual self.
If I seem different... then I think it's probably because I've decided to be honest to myself.
During the weekend, when we met on the platform. It was only for a moment, but before we parted... you were honest with me.
Even after all the pain we've caused each other, I realized that we could still be happy if we were true to our feelings.
That's why I've decided to be honest with myself.
...I can now do things like this.
Hey... that's going a bit too far.

File.name: 05-KG-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Your boyfriend's been caught by the worst kind of person imaginable!
It's this girl I went to school with. She's, like, in pheromone overdrive mode.
Look, basically, there's this girl who's awful, but she's a hit with the guys.
And she's been hitting on Itou.
He was making this kind of troubled expression.
But then, she snuggles right up to him and presses her breasts against him, and he didn't turn her away.
Anyhow, she's bad news. Everyone in junior high hated that pheromone girl. We'd all just ignore her.
I-is there really a person like that?
B-but why would someone like her approach Makoto?
I don't know. After all, they don't have anything in common.
Didn't I mention her before? She was making moves on Sawanaga, too...
Ah, he's here. I'll see you later.
Sure is a nice day today, huh?
Nice weather on a Monday like this just kind of makes you want to go out and play, doesn't it?
With whom...? Well, with you, for example.
That sounded a bit deliberate. Forced, almost.
You were thinking about going with another girl, weren't you?
Huh? Why do you say that?
Did you meet with anyone this morning?
Huh...? All I did was come to school like usual.
You weren't doing anything questionable with another girl?
What? What's with that suspicious look?
You have that cheating look about you.
How rude. Don't say such unpleasant things on a Monday morning.
Still, now that you mention it, it's unusual that Ko...
...Looks like Taisuke's calling for me. I'll be going, okay?

File.name: 05-KG-C01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: The one she really loves... huh?
That's how much she thinks of me, and yet...

File.name: 05-KG-C02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah... that's got to be it.
Why else... would my heart be pounding so hard like this...?

File.name: 05-KG-C03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah... after all, I've already got Sekai.
I can't keep thinking about Kotonoha.

File.name: 05-KG-C04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: No, I shouldn't even be thinking about her.
I can barely keep my mind off her, but... I've already got Sekai...

File.name: 05-KG-C05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Haah... finally, it's over. Where do you want to eat today, Sekai?

File.name: 05-KG-C07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: This is bad! She's going to steal him!
She said she wanted to talk about something, so I brought her over.
So, what did you want talk about?
W-well... I wanted to speak with Saionji-san and Makoto-kun...
What? Are you saying that I'm not welcome here?
Ah, no. In that case, please join us...
Forget it. I don't want to be any place you are.
Uh... well, as I was saying, I wanted to speak with you two.
Would you... like to have lunch together?
I... thought it would be nice if the three of us could eat the way we used to, like good friends...

File.name: 05-KG-C08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Um... are you just going to leave her?
Katsura-san. She's looking over this way.

File.name: 05-KG-C09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: W-well, actually... I came to invite you two to lunch.
If it's all right with you, I thought it would be wonderful if we could have lunch together again...

File.name: 05-KG-C10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah, that sounds good. Let's do it.
You don't mind, do you, Sekai?

File.name: 05-KG-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So, what did you want to talk about?
She called me last night and said, 'I can't give up on the person I really love!', or something...

File.name: 05-KG-D01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hey! Did Kotonoha-san say anything to you?
You're the one she really loves, right?! It's got to be because of you!
So you say, but I can't think of anything...
Liar! You've done something, haven't you?!

File.name: 05-KG-D02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Liar! You and Saionji are up to something!
Whatever you say... besides, didn't you see how surprised we were when you came and said you were going out with her?!
Yeah, but still, something doesn't feel right!

File.name: 05-KG-D03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: 'I can't give up on the person I really love'... huh?

File.name: 05-KG-E00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I've got some bread from the store in front of the station.
Did you know that the piroshki there is actually pretty good?
That's the first I've heard about it.
I've even got some here today. Would you like some?
Okay, I'll trade you for my bread.

File.name: 05-KG-F00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I forgot to bring a drink.
If you like, I could give you some of my lemonade.
N-no... I think I'll have something non-sweet.
What are you being so picky for? Didn't you once say that her lemonade was delicious?
Y-yeah, but I'd like something non-sweet today, like tea or something.
Hey, Katsura-san, could you come with me for a second?
What? Why don't I just go and buy it for you?
It's okay. You don't mind, do you, Katsura-san?
Go and wait for us on the roof, Makoto.
I thought you were going out with Taisuke, and yet, you suddenly start getting all close with Makoto.
Are you trying to do something to Makoto? Would you mind cutting it out? It's just not...
Oh, come now... weren't you the one who made the first move on him?
You seduced him, knowing full well that he was going out with me.
Did you think of that after hearing about how I was too embarrassed to even hold his hand?
In fact, the only reason we're in this present situation is because you blinded him with your sex appeal.
You did it on the roof, didn't you?
From what I saw, he was taking you from behind, and you were moaning in pleasure.
Well, I've worked hard to catch up to you,
and now I know how good being taken from behind can feel, too. It's quite...
Very well, then, I won't. I don't want to think about anyone seducing my boyfriend, either.
Oh, that's right. You wanted to know why I was getting close to Makoto-kun. Well, I've decided to be honest with myself.
After all, even now, I just love him so much.
Right now, you might believe that you are his girlfriend...
...Now, are you going to buy some non-sweet tea?
I'll be going back first, so feel free to take your time.
I'd appreciate the head start. I have been out of the game for a long time, you know.

File.name: 05-KG-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Haah... guess I'll just go home.
Do you want to stop by Pure Burger today?
Come on, why not? Have you tried their new lychee shake?
That's not even a new promotion. The last new item was the rambutan shake, and that finished last summer, right?
The lychee shake is good too, you know.
Well, I guess it was pretty good... hmm, I wouldn't mind one.
Fine, I guess I'll have to. Let's go.
Cut it out with the crying, Sawanaga.
Eh...?! Oh, yeah! Let's go and do something.
W-what?! If you're going to say stuff like that, then forget it!
Well, then, why don't we take the opportunity to go over to Hikari's house?
It's close to mine, so I can get home quickly even if it gets late.
Don't decide based on something trivial like that!
Sawanaga, do you know about Hikari's house?
Come to think of it, you've moved, haven't you? Back in junior high, you used to live close to my place.
It's a brand new house! Kuroda House, the house with the lovely wooden smell!
I... think I'd like to see that.
Right. I can't just sit here crying. I should start getting ready.
Nanami! Why my house, all of a sudden?!
Sawanaga's all depressed from the shock of being dumped. This is your chance!♪
When the time is right, I'll disappear first. Just report the results to me tomorrow.
What are you so shocked about?
Listen, you...! You can't just suddenly call out like that from behind someone!

File.name: 05-KG-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: This lychee shake first came out when we were in primary school, didn't it?
Yeah. I think it was... around 6th grade.
This sure brings back memories.... what sort of stuff did you do for fun when you were in primary school?
Our neighborhood, Motehara-sakashita, was named for its steep slopes. I used to blade down them all the time.
We live by the sea, so I'd usually go and play by the seaside.
Isn't the sea just great? At my last job, I was working at this restaurant called Summer Radish in Haramihama.
I know the place. It's pretty far from my house, though, so I've never been there.
Come over and hang out the next time I'm working there. I'll treat you to something.
Seriously? Okay, then, I'm going for sure.
It'll only be during the summer, though.
Urgh... I see. That's a long wait.
Why don't the three of us... just stop having lunch together?
After all... things aren't the way they used to be between us anymore.
But Kotonoha said she wanted to eat with us.
Aren't I the one who's your girlfriend?!
Having Katsura-san there makes me nervous!
I-I see... sorry, I hadn't noticed.
It's okay... look, next time, if she comes, I'll turn her down.
Haha... still got more to say?
Don't pick up, even if she calls you!

File.name: 05-KI-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Saionji-san... was it all just a lie...?
Makoto-kun... he said that he loved me... and yet...
Or could it be that Saionji-san is the one stringing Makoto-kun along...?

File.name: 05-KI-A01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I wonder if she's on the phone with Makoto-kun...

File.name: 05-KI-A02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What's onee-chan doing in the kitchen?
She says she's making lunch for tomorrow.
Are you sure she doesn't need your help?
She said she didn't need it. She's going to make it all on her own.
Aww... you've gotten on her bad side.
You're right. She won't tell me a thing about her boyfriend, and even though I tell her to bring him over, she...
...Is she really going to be okay?

File.name: 05-KI-A03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: She's at it again today, isn't she?
Maybe things went well after all.
You mean with Makoto-kun, right? I wish he'd come over to play again.
So do I! If it looks like he's about to come over, be sure to let me know!
Don't give up! Let's hope for the best.

File.name: 05-KI-B01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Eheheh... nice day today, isn't it?
Is it really just the weather that's making you so cheerful?
Things are going well with Itou, aren't they?
I still don't know... it feels like we're getting back to the way we were before,
but we're still a long way away from eating lunch together like we used to...
Well, you just leave the enemies on the outside to us.
Quick, nothing. Yamamoto said he didn't know what you were talking about.
Stop screwing around with me. I looked like a real idiot, you know.
Oh, calm down. Here, I'll give you a few meal tickets.
Eh...?! Okay, but are you sure?
Take them. It's my way of apologizing.
Somehow, I get the feeling that I'm being bought off... but thanks.
Don't mention it. I'll give you one for spaghetti and one for meal set A.
Don't worry about it. I'm giving you two, so go and eat with Sekai or something.
Yeah, that's right. You should go too, Sekai.
Nanami's treat, huh...? Maybe I will, then.

File.name: 05-KI-B02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: And now, we come to graphs of quadratic functions and coefficients...
Now, this is a basic problem which should serve as a review. Obuchi, read this part out loud.
Given the following graph for the quadratic function\nax2 + bx + c, solve for a, b, c, b2-4ac...
Very good. Now, what do we do with the graph in (1)?
Okay, I'll take care of it.
Oh dear. Did it get caught on something?
Katsura-san, would you mind not making a mess in class?
This was your fault, you know. Be sure to clean up the floor so it's nice and spotless, okay?
She just doesn't learn, does she? You've let everyone in the girls' basketball club know too, right?
Yeah. They all said they'd help.
That idiot. And after we told her to leave Itou alone, too.

File.name: 05-KI-B03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: There are still breadcrumbs on the edge of the floor.
I'm sorry! I'll clean them up right away.

File.name: 05-KI-B04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: If you do anything more to Kotonoha, I'm going to get angry.
Don't play dumb. You've been urging the girls from the sports clubs and class 4 to pick on her, haven't you?

File.name: 05-KI-B05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Katsura... haven't you learned your lesson yet?
What are you planning on doing with that lunch?
Don't expect any mercy from us just because it's smaller than yesterday's.
You're the one who needs to stop!
This is a class matter. It's none of your business, so get lost.
What are you talking about? You're in class 3.
That's why I can't just stand by and watch her about to get hit.
Are you in on this bullying, too?
You're just going along with your club, right?
Can you please make them stop?
I know you can do it. You're in the girls' basketball club with Kanroji, after all.
I guess I might be able to...
The rest of you had better leave her alone from now on, too.

File.name: 05-KI-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What did you want to talk about?
Seducing...? What are you talking about?
He isn't the kind of person you think he is... the truth is, he's in love with me!
I'd always thought that there was nothing I could do, because you were the one he loved.
But... if he doesn't love you anymore... then I don't want to hold back.
Ever since I met Makoto at the entrance ceremony... I've been in love with him.
That's why I'm not going to hide it anymore.
I'm not going to just give up anymore.
I'm not going to run away anymore.
I'm... not going to hesitate anymore.

File.name: 05-KI-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah, it looks like Mom's back. I'll call again later. Huh? Yeah, okay. All right. Good night.
It's not one of your junior high friends.
Ufufu... that's a cute girlfriend you have there. I was quite surprised.

File.name: 05-KI-D01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Eh...?! But she told me that she was.
She's just... someone who hangs around and bothers me.
That's not how she seemed to me...
I'm sorry, Makoto is just so...
What a thing to do to such a pretty girl...
The truth is, Makoto-kun and I are quarrelling. I thought I could come and make up with him... but it can't be helped.
Haah... yes, you're right. Makoto is just...
Despite the way he acts, he's really not a bad boy. Please remain friends with him.
What a well-mannered child... unlike a certain Makoto.

File.name: 05-KI-D02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You'll introduce her to me, won't you?

File.name: 05-KI-D03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Why are you freezing up? Is it that shocking to have your mother find out about her?
Go on, she's in the living room.
Oh, she'll be leaving soon, so I'll walk her back.
It's okay to take it easy, you know... although I suppose her parents might be worried about her coming back late.

File.name: 05-KI-D05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry... I'm just so happy...
Hey, you're heading home now, right?
That's why I'll walk you. It's dangerous out there at night.

File.name: 05-KI-D06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm so sorry. I came all the way to your door...
but I was just thinking about turning back when I ran into your mother, and...
Haah... that sounds like her, all right.
You're going home, right? I'll walk you.

File.name: 05-KI-D07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry... I was thinking of going home, but then I ran into your mother, so...
You're going home, right? I'll walk you.
What choice do I have? Come on, let's go.

File.name: 05-KI-E00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's the first time we've walked together like this.
Yeah, even though you only live in the next town over.
...Perhaps we even passed each other by as children.
Of course, I spent most of my time at practice up through junior high, so I didn't get to go out often.
Piano, ballet, dance, calligraphy... all sorts of things.
But you don't practice them anymore?
Yes, I stopped all of them once I graduated from junior high.
My mother told me to keep them up until junior high... but I made her promise to let me stop if I got into the academy.
And so you did... kind of feels like a waste, though.
Because once I did... I was able to meet you.
Throughout junior high, I'd think of nothing but practice,
and even though my friends would invite me out, I was... less than sociable.
So when Saionji-san invited me out, I might not have accepted. When I think of it like that, I'm glad I stopped.
About the way things ended up.
Ended up...? I don't think it's over just yet.
No, it's not. We're just having a quarrel, aren't we? I'd... like to make up with you.
...It doesn't have to be right away. Even if it's just little by little...
I wouldn't mind starting all over again as friends... and giving it one more try...
If you don't hate me, that is... even if it's just as acquaintances...
I never did, to begin with... I just got angry and said some awful things.
...Shall we start from there and give it another try?

File.name: 05-KI-F02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Excuse us for just a second!
Ah... oh, it's just you, Kanroji.
You usually don't say a word to me when you see me on the train.
That's all in the past now. Let's try this again. Good morning.
