File.PrintText: It's a very cold day today, isn't it? The weather report said it was likely to snow.
Wouldn't it be romantic if it did? It would be the most wonderful Christmas Eve ever.
Of course, it will still be wonderful, even if it doesn't snow.

File.name: 05-SB-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's fine. Just go to sleep.
I think that would be for the best.
...Hold my hand until I fall asleep.

File.name: 05-SB-G01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...I'm sorry for dragging you along like this.
I was worried, so I just came by to check on you after class.
You were sleeping pretty soundly, so I asked the teacher not to wake you. Should I have?
Are you sure you should be here? You're supposed to be spending Christmas with your boyfriend, right?
I'll rush to see him afterwards.
It'll be a Christmas with him and his little sister, you see. Haha...
I tried to stop him, you know! It was terrible of him to just leave you here at a time like this!

File.name: 05-SB-G02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: No, it was! But get this! He said he had something he absolutely had to do...
Really, I appreciate it... I'm all right now, so you can get going.

File.name: 05-SB-G03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Why don't you spend Christmas with us?
I'm fine with having an extra person around.
Come on. If you and senpai's little sister get along, maybe I'll get the chance to be alone with him!
You sure know how to use someone. What kind of person would assign a job like that to a friend who's as depressed as I am?
Ahaha... well, you've just been asked.
I guess I've got no choice...

File.name: 05-SB-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...It's your fault that she's been acting strange, isn't it?

File.name: 05-SB-H02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Are you just going to keep playing dumb?
Just now... when Sekai was crying, I could hear her whispering your name.

File.name: 05-SB-H03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: That's an answer in itself, isn't it?

File.name: 05-SB-H04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Unlike Hikari, I didn't mind that you were going out with Sekai.
I knew that she's liked you ever since the entrance ceremony,
and she always looked so happy when she talked about you.
But then... you started eating with her and going out together... and just look at what happened!
Ever since she started going out with you, she's looked gloomy all the time!
You're her boyfriend, aren't you? Didn't you start going out with her because you love her?
You do love her, don't you?
If you do, then why aren't you making her happy?!
Why don't you let her keep smiling?!
She cries all the time, now! I don't want to see her like that, you know! I'll never recognize you as her boyfriend!
If you hurt her any more... I won't forgive you.

File.name: 05-SB-H05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: If she cheers up after this, it'll be thanks to Itou, won't it?
Sheesh, she sure is a handful.
You think they'll be okay? Things seemed kind of awkward between them.
They're just embarrassed. It'll be fine!
There's no need to worry. Now then, shall we go to the cafeteria?
Sure, that might be nice once in a while.
Huh? U-uh, guys? Aren't we going to buy drinks?
Don't worry about it. Come on, you're coming, too.
Eh? You mean we're just going to go to the cafeteria and not come back?
B-but... isn't that kind of mean?
You're such an idiot. Look, just come with us.
Oooh, it'll be fine. Come on, let's go!

File.name: 05-SB-I00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's... such a wonderful Christmas Eve... isn't... it...?

File.name: 05-SB-I02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I know now... that I love you more than anything.
No matter who I have to hurt... I'll never stop loving you.
You don't need to worry about that.
It's a sign... of my resolve.
My resolve to love you... and only you... for the rest of my life.
I know... and I swear to love you too... Makoto-kun!
All that fear I've felt up until now... it's as if it were never there.
I had no idea that it felt so wonderful to do it with someone I love.
I want to be with you like this... always.

File.name: 05-SC-A02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What's onee-chan doing in the kitchen?
She says she's making lunch for tomorrow.
Are you sure she doesn't need your help?
She said she didn't need it. She's going to make it all on her own.
Aww... you've gotten on her bad side.
You're right. She won't tell me a thing about her boyfriend, and even though I tell her to bring him over, she...
...Is she really going to be okay?

File.name: 05-SC-A03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: She's at it again today, isn't she?
Maybe things went well after all.
You mean with Makoto-kun, right? I wish he'd come over to play again.
So do I! If it looks like he's about to come over, be sure to let me know!
Don't give up! Let's hope for the best.

File.name: 05-SC-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: From: Katsura Kotonoha | Title: Sorry to bother you\nThere's something I want to talk to you about. I'll be waiting in the courtyard after class.

File.name: 05-SC-B01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Eheheh... nice day today, isn't it?
Is it really just the weather that's making you so cheerful?
Things are going well with Itou, aren't they?
Kind of, you say? That's a lie.
It's true. We both went through a lot before we started going out, so Makoto said we ought to take it slow.
Kwah! She's boasting! She's totally boasting now!
Hey, you're the one who asked! If you're just going to make fun of me, I'm not going to say any more!
We want to hear the rest!
Well... I promised to go over to his place and hang out sometime soon.
So, you're finally becoming an adult, too.
I-it might be nothing, you know...
Listen, when you're going to your boyfriend's place to hang out, it's never just 'nothing'.
You think... it's like that, after all?
Was it like that for you, too?
I want to hear about it! For reference!
Uuh... whenever I go to my boyfriend's place, there's less than a one in five chance it ends up in sex.
So that's how these things work, huh?
I don't think so. My boyfriend's just strange.
We're all alone in his room, but instead of paying attention to me, he just plays games on his computer. Those anime ones!
He recommended some to me once, but I said I wasn't interested and he hasn't mentioned it since.
You think I should have offered to play with him?
Uwah... that's not exactly ideal either, right? He sounds like a total geek.
I'm fine with that! The problem is, I'm starting to think he likes those games better than me...
Maybe he's thinking, 'Nanami's so dashing that it's scary!'
Sekai's boyfriend might be a strange one too, you know?
I don't know about that. Didn't he say before that he had a little sister?
Maybe he and his sister still take baths together to this very day!
Yeah, he said that they do.
Oh, I see... talk about boring. Well, what about...
Stop trying to set him up as some kind of pervert.
Quick, nothing. Yamamoto said he didn't know what you were talking about.
Stop screwing around with me. I looked like a real idiot, you know.
Oh, calm down. Here, I'll give you a few meal tickets.
Eh...?! Okay, but are you sure?
Take them. It's my way of apologizing.
Somehow, I get the feeling that I'm being bought off... but thanks.
Don't mention it. I'll give you one for spaghetti and one for meal set A.
Don't worry about it. I'm giving you two, so go and eat with Sekai or something.
Yeah, that's right. You should go too, Sekai.
Nanami's treat, huh...? Maybe I will, then.

File.name: 05-SC-B02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: And now, we come to graphs of quadratic functions and coefficients...
Now, this is a basic problem which should serve as a review. Obuchi, read this part out loud.
Given the following graph for the quadratic function\nax2 + bx + c, solve for a, b, c, b2-4ac...
Very good. Now, what do we do with the graph in (1)?
Okay, I'll take care of it.
Oh dear. Did it get caught on something?
Katsura-san, would you mind not making a mess in class?
This was your fault, you know. Be sure to clean up the floor so it's nice and spotless, okay?
She just doesn't learn, does she? You've let everyone in the girls' basketball club know too, right?
Yeah. They all said they'd help.
That idiot. And after we told her to leave Itou alone, too.

File.name: 05-SC-B03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: There are still breadcrumbs on the edge of the floor.
I'm sorry! I'll clean them up right away.

File.name: 05-SC-B04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: If you do anything more to Kotonoha, I'm going to get angry.
Don't play dumb. You've been urging the girls from the sports clubs and class 4 to pick on her, haven't you?
I don't even want to speak to you.
Whatever you try, I'm going to protect Kotonoha with everything I've got.

File.name: 05-SC-B05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Katsura... haven't you learned your lesson yet?
What are you planning on doing with that lunch?
Don't expect any mercy from us just because it's smaller than yesterday's.
You're the one who needs to stop!
This is a class matter. It's none of your business, so get lost.
What are you talking about? You're in class 3.
That's why I can't just stand by and watch her about to get hit.
Are you in on this bullying, too?
You're just going along with your club, right?
Can you please make them stop?
I know you can do it. You're in the girls' basketball club with Kanroji, after all.
I guess I might be able to...
The rest of you had better leave her alone from now on, too.

File.name: 05-SC-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What did you want to talk about?
He isn't the kind of person you think he is... the truth is, he's in love with me!
It's just that he made a mistake and told you that he loves you...
So maybe because of that, you might like him, too... but he's my boyfriend!
You know... I've always been in love with Makoto.
But I thought that he loved you, so I tried to set him up with you. I caused him so much trouble.
Makoto told me he loved me from the very beginning... but I couldn't be honest with myself.
That's not true... what are you talking about, after all this time?
Weren't you the one who said that we suited each other? ...You're acting strange today, Saionji-san.
I've been acting strange for a long time, now.
But from now on, I'm going to be honest with myself. I love Makoto.
I did something really terrible to you, and I don't expect you to forgive me no matter what I say... but still, I'm sorry.
I'm going to go out with Makoto.

File.name: 05-SC-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah, it looks like Mom's back. I'll call again later. Huh? Yeah, okay. All right. Good night.
It's not one of your junior high friends.
Fufu... it's your cute girlfriend. I was so surprised!

File.name: 05-SC-D01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Eh...?! But she told me that she was.
She's just... someone who hangs around and bothers me.
That's not how she seemed to me...
I'm sorry, Makoto is just so...
What a thing to do to such a pretty girl...
The truth is, Makoto-kun and I are quarrelling. I thought I could come and make up with him... but it can't be helped.
Haah... yes, you're right. Makoto is just...
Despite the way he acts, he's really not a bad boy. Please remain friends with him.
What a well-mannered child... unlike a certain Makoto.

File.name: 05-SC-D02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You'll introduce her to me, won't you?

File.name: 05-SC-D03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Why are you freezing up? Is it that shocking to have your mother find out about her?
Go on, she's in the living room.
Oh, she'll be leaving soon, so I'll walk her back.
It's okay to take it easy, you know... although I suppose her parents might be worried about her coming back late.

File.name: 05-SC-D05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry... I'm just so happy...
Hey, you're heading home now, right?
That's why I'll walk you. It's dangerous out there at night.

File.name: 05-SC-D06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm so sorry. I came all the way to your door...
but I was just thinking about turning back when I ran into your mother, and...
Haah... that sounds like her, all right.
You're going home, right? I'll walk you.

File.name: 05-SC-D07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry... I was thinking of going home, but then I ran into your mother, so...
You're going home, right? I'll walk you.
What choice do I have? Come on, let's go.

File.name: 05-SC-E00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's the first time we've walked together like this.
Yeah, even though you only live in the next town over.
...Perhaps we even passed each other by as children.
Of course, I spent most of my time at practice up through junior high, so I didn't get to go out often.
Piano, ballet, dance, calligraphy... all sorts of things.
But you don't practice them anymore?
Yes, I stopped all of them once I graduated from junior high.
My mother told me to keep them up until junior high... but I made her promise to let me stop if I got into the academy.
And so you did... kind of feels like a waste, though.
Because once I did... I was able to meet you.
Throughout junior high, I'd think of nothing but practice,
and even though my friends would invite me out, I was... less than sociable.
So when Saionji-san invited me out, I might not have accepted. When I think of it like that, I'm glad I stopped.
About the way things ended up.
Ended up...? I don't think it's over just yet.
No, it's not. We're just having a quarrel, aren't we? I'd... like to make up with you.
...It doesn't have to be right away. Even if it's just little by little...
I wouldn't mind starting all over again as friends... and giving it one more try...
If you don't hate me, that is... even if it's just as acquaintances...
I never did, to begin with... I just got angry and said some awful things.
...Shall we start from there and give it another try?

File.name: 05-SC-F02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Excuse us for just a second!
Ah... oh, it's just you, Kanroji.
You usually don't say a word to me when you see me on the train.
That's all in the past now. Let's try this again. Good morning.
Say, don't you feel kind of bored on the way to school? Wouldn't it be nice to have someone to talk to?
Kuroda's standing right over there, isn't she? Go talk to her.
Oh, naturally. She'll talk too, right?

File.name: 05-SC-F03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: S-so, were you watching TV yesterday?

File.name: 05-SC-F05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: The show that's like 'From the Train Window of Space'.
The one with the grand music that shows the earth and the stars from different angles every month?
That thing puts you to sleep in three seconds flat.
No way, it's totally interesting. Right, Hikari?
Why do I have to talk to someone like Itou...?
So... what did you do last night?

SetSELECT.sel2: 'I spoke with Sekai on the phone'

File.name: 05-SC-F06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well, Kotonoha came over, and that's about it...
So, she comes over to play at night.

File.name: 05-SC-F07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I spoke with Sekai on the phone.
Don't think that I approve of you and Sekai being... gwah!
I-it's nothing, don't worry about it.
But... not even boxers usually deliver that kind of punch to the guts.
S-so, I see. You and Sekai talk on the phone at night. Hahaha, you two sure are close.
So, are you just going to ignore Kuroda like that?

File.name: 05-SC-F08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Weren't you on the phone or anything?
Yeah, Sekai called, and we ended up talking for ages.... wait, how did you know that?
Hey, stop laughing and start taking care of Kuroda.

File.name: 05-SC-F09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah. It's just a pain to have her turn up at night like that.
Yeah, you're right. No one likes annoying girls like that, do they?

File.name: 05-SC-F10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Uwah! Hey! What are you turning all red for?!

File.name: 05-SC-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yamamoto said to come to the staff room right now.
Liar. I haven't done anything lately to earn a lecture from him.
Besides, when did you hear that, anyway?
Yamamoto supervises the tennis club after class. He's got nothing to do with girls' basketball!
I-I ran into him on the way home.
You'll find out once you go, right?
Itou's already got a girlfriend called Saionji Sekai. All you're doing by hanging around is bothering him!
Yeah. I don't like to admit it, but they suit each other, and we're going to support them.
Consider yourself warned. Stay away from Itou.
Remember, you promised. Let's go, Hikari.

File.name: 05-SC-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: He said he was going to the cafeteria.

File.name: 05-SC-H02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Phew... that was kind of scary.
Haha... well, Katou and I know each other, so I figured it would be okay.
And... you called me your girlfriend.
No. I'd... like to be your girlfriend, too.
I'm... I'm sorry... I... I didn't... know...
I'm sorry! This was all my idea, and Sekai didn't know about any of it! So...!
Of course she didn't! That kind of thing is...

File.name: 05-SC-I01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: She's with the girls' basketball club. You know, for that thing.
They're doing this for Kanroji-san from class 3, right?
You think Katsura was going out with him?
Maybe, but making a move on him was a mistake. He's some guy that Katsura-san's friend likes.
That girl from class 3... what's her name? Uh... oh, right. Saionji-san.
So, she's the one pulling the strings from the dark shadows.
Doesn't 'dark shadows' sound kind of weird?
Well, among us, Kanroji-san's basketball club and some of the other clubs, it looks like Katsura's in for a rough time.
But still, Otome and that guy from class 3... they're... you know... right?
Well, no wonder she's working so hard.
You got it. Did you see that expression on Katsura's face?
Yeah, yeah. She was totally tearing up. What a classic.
Who the hell brings a big lunchbox like that to school?
That was an awesome kick, Kumi.
It was fine when I caught my leg on it, right? But it totally went flying when Kumi kicked it.
It wouldn't have gone that well without the help from your foot.
You might just make it to the J-league!

File.name: 05-SC-J02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Are you on your way home?

File.name: 05-SC-J03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ufufu... you'll find out soon enough.

File.name: 05-SC-K00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Eh? Today? I have a school lunch...
I mean tomorrow... would you like to have lunch together?

File.name: 05-SC-K01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It'd be nice to be able to enjoy lunch on the roof again, just like back when we first met.

File.name: 05-SC-K02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...I've made plans to have lunch with Sekai tomorrow.
There's someone who's more important to me than my friends... please understand.

File.name: 05-SC-K03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sorry, would you mind leaving us alone for a second?
I want to speak with Kotonoha.

File.name: 05-SC-L00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Um... I made some lunch... but... I-I'm so clumsy... I tripped and dropped it...
And now, all I have left... is tea...
It's okay. Come on, let's buy something.
Look, I'll go, then. How's bread...? Well, I guess there's not much choice at this hour.

File.name: 05-SC-L01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I was... really looking forward to this lunch...
Yeah, looks like we missed out this time.
I'm sorry... this is all my fault...
I'll bring lunch too, so we can trade.

File.name: 05-SC-L03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You mixed up the sugar and salt... haha...
I guess I should thank the girls from class 4.
Ooh... please don't say that. Ah! Makoto-kun... you knew about that...?
It's okay. Just work on improving it, one step at a time.
We've still got plenty of time. Enough time for your lunch to get as good as this.
Ooh... compared to this, mine is so...
Hey, like I said, don't feel down!
Okay, then... I'll keep trying my best!
...You mustn't blush at a mere indirect kiss.
After all, we decided that we're going to be boyfriend and girlfriend.

File.name: 05-SD-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah. It's a mess in here, so don't start digging around.
We're a single-parent family, so it's just me and my mom.
Don't worry, my dad's not dead or anything. They're just divorced. I've got a little sister who lives with him, too.
Her name's 'Itaru', like in the character for 'stop'. My dad's name is 'Tomaru', with the same character.
Their name plate just has two of the same characters, so it's kind of confusing... haha.
Well, I don't know why you're here, but it's usually just me, so make yourself at home.
My mom's a nurse, so she's hardly ever home.
Yeah. She just left for her evening shift, so she won't be back until morning.
Still... I sure am surprised to see you come to my house.
Me, too. I didn't think I had the courage in me.
You're in your uniform. Are you on your way back from school? Must be tough being a class rep.
I see. So, what can I do for you?

File.name: 05-SD-A01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's been a year since Sekai transferred away. I'm in second year, now.
Little by little, the e-mails and letters we once sent to each other so often grew fewer...
Until finally, I stopped replying altogether, having never been good with letters.
Maybe it was because I failed to stop Sekai back then... but Kioura and the others have grown distant from me, too.
The lively days of the past are gone, and now, I'm stuck living this empty shell of a life.
Meeting and going out with girls at random, then breaking up with them and starting all over again.
I've gotten used to it all, now...
There was a letter for you.
It's air mail. I wonder where it's from? Fwah! It's from France!
Eh?! Are you sure you want to do that?!
Really? Still, that's impressive. You've got someone writing to you from overseas. Maybe it's even a love letter!
I bet you get tons of those.
Yep. After all, the plan was for all three of us to hang out together.
...How did things end up like this?

File.name: 05-SD-A03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Somehow, it feels like I'm deceiving Sekai...
I know it's to stop her from transferring away, but...
Well, I can't say I wasn't personally looking forward to it, too.
Kioura... what should we do now?
Make up and be friends with Sekai again.
Give her your support. Don't ever let her hug her knees and cry again.
...Because I won't be able to protect her anymore.

File.name: 05-SD-A04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Kioura... was that your first time?
I thought she liked you more than this.
Haah... if even this won't work, then she's never going to...
Just a little more, and she might have reconsidered. Come on, let's give it another try...
...As long as it's a girl, you don't care who it is, do you?
I-it's true. I really do think you're cute! Ah, and that's not something I say to other girls, either.
I... I love Sekai. That's why I agreed with your plan, right?

File.name: 05-SD-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sekai? It's about time you get up!
Mom, when did you get home?
Just now. I'm going to go to sleep once I finish cooking.
You know, Sekai, I've been thinking.
I just can't leave you here on your own. I want you to understand that.
Paris is a nice place, you know. Ah, I brought back some dried plums for you, too. Dried plums from Paris. Tasteful, right?
You know, back when they held the World's Fair there, Napoleon III sent a delegation just to...
Be sure to give some serious thought to transferring... oh, I guess you can't hear me.
Fwah... I should get some sleep.

File.name: 05-SD-B01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You said that the two of you were going to be separated, and that it couldn't be helped.
And once you are, he's going to forget about you... so it's okay if I take him, right?
Do you still remember? Back when you first fell in love with him...
He helped me at the entrance ceremony... and then, the two of us started to talk about him.
Back then, didn't you ever think that I loved him, too?
I've loved him since the first time I met him.
He saw me holding back my tears even as I was surrounded by boys,
and he said that if I was so strong-willed, I should become a class rep.
Ever since then... just being a class rep made me feel proud,
all because of what he said...
But...! Makoto... he hasn't said that he likes you.
It's true that right now, he loves you.
But you told him that you're giving up on him and transferring to Paris... and that really shook him.
I didn't just give up on...
Paris is just too far away, isn't it?
Yes... but if we try hard...
You know better than anyone that it's futile, don't you?
What's more, Itou knows that you're going to try and forget about him, too.
I've already told him that you planned to transfer without telling him.
No! You heard from Mom, didn't you?! It's all happening suddenly because of her job.
I heard it from your mother... and I'm your childhood friend, so he believed me right away.
Setsuna... don't tell me that you...?
I told you, didn't I? I'll be taking him.
Stop it! Don't take Makoto from me!
If I don't, then someone else will. That'd be even worse.
There isn't anyone else! There's only me!
It can't be helped. You're transferring away.
It can be helped... I can't let this happen...
I don't have time to deal with you anymore.
Another girl who's got her eye on Itou.
You'll start avoiding and hating her if I tell you who it is, so I won't say.
You get so devoted when it comes to Itou... or should I say, jealous?
That's why I've got to go now.
I held back while you were here, but...
The place by his side is no longer reserved for you.
...Why don't you just give up and transfer away?
I don't want to... I don't...

File.name: 05-SD-B03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Itou... take your clothes off, too.
Makoto! Makoto! Don't! Don't kiss her...!
We just... might be a good match for each other.
Ah... haah... don't stare so much.
Ah... if you suck on them, I'll...
I... Sekai is the one I...

File.name: 05-SD-B04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'll make you forget all about her...
I don't want him to do it with any other girls! Not... not ever...!
I'm not going to leave you... I won't transfer away, so Makoto... don't do it with anyone else...
I'll take up a room at Summer Radish.
I'll work there part-time while going to school. No matter what happens, I'm not transferring away!
I'm not going to just hand him over to someone like you!
Makoto! You're over there, aren't you?! If you're there, answer me!
Makoto! I'm definitely not going to leave you... so please, don't have sex with her...
I won't... because I love you, Sekai.
Makoto... I... I love you, too... I love you so much...

File.name: 05-SD-B05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah... it's all the way inside, now.
It feels so good inside you.

File.name: 05-SD-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Don't worry. Leave it all to me.
Then you understand how it is.
I'm going to be taking Itou for myself.
Wait, taking? I'm not an object, you know.
What's this? Is Itou up to no good again?
Y-yeah. I... finally understood after she confessed to me. It's better for me to go out with her.
What?! Do you even know what you're saying?!
Setsuna... this isn't a joke, is it?
You wanted me gone... you've always had your sights set on him, haven't you?
She didn't say that! Right, Setsuna?
Why does it matter to you? You're not going to be around anymore.
That's terrible, Setsuna... I've always thought of you as someone I could trust, a friend who was even closer than family.
You don't have to worry about Sekai. She's going to be transferring away from here.
Are you going to be transferring away?
But, I mean...! I can't help it!
That's right! I'm leaving! Forget it! Forget everything, because I'm leaving! You and Setsuna can do whatever you want!
Are you sure we did the right thing?

File.name: 05-SD-C01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah. I saw the weather forecast, and they said something about some cold waves coming this way today.
You're cutting it pretty close today, aren't you? Yamamoto's going to be here in a minute.
Well, it's all good, as long as I'm not late. I was listening to the radio, and I ended up staying up late, you see.
You know, the one with the afro guy.
Oh, that one... that's a pretty good show, huh?
I've been listening to the radio recently myself, and...

File.name: 05-SD-C02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What's wrong? I heard you disappeared as soon as you came in this morning.
You ended up getting marked absent... want me to go and tell the teacher?
He said he was going to hang out at Sakakino Hills with Setsuna.
That was awful of her, wasn't it? Taking aim at Itou like that as soon as she heard you're transferring.
I just don't get what she sees in him... you're better off quickly forgetting about a guy like that, you know.
There's no way I can forget about him...
I... love him... I don't want to forget about him...
Are you sure he doesn't love you still?
he didn't really seem enthusiastic about it. It was more like Setsuna was pulling him along.
He was worried when you didn't come back.
Still, there's no helping it, is there? After all, you're transferring away.
There's no choice but to give up... at least, that's what I heard Itou say.
I overheard him when he was feeling down and talking to Sawanaga during lunch.
Hey, listen. Sawanaga and I have been getting closer, lately.
Of course, with a strong rival like Katsura, there's still a long way to go,
but just yesterday, he... ah, Sekai...

File.name: 05-SD-C03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sekai... she's away again today, isn't she?
Ah, hey, you know, I've made some progress myself.
Uh-huh! Yesterday, he called me again!
Wow, that's incredible... but he's still not coming to lunch, is he?
I wonder if she's taking the day off again today.
It's already Friday... what is she doing?
I'm sure she's at home, crying.
She's always been like that. Whenever something painful happens, she abandons everything and stays at home to cry.
I'd always be the one who'd go and comfort her, telling her to cheer up.
But... I can't do that anymore.
...And even knowing that, we're still going to do it today?
It's not that I don't want to, but...

File.name: 05-SD-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What's this about? Let's hurry up and finish so we can go back inside.

File.name: 05-SD-D01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'll forgive you... for what happened with Setsuna.
Even if we become separated, we'll always be a couple...
Tell me that you'll always love me, even if I transfer to another school.

File.name: 05-SD-D02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: To be honest... right now, I just don't know what to tell you.
All of a sudden, I hear that you're going to transfer away...
Even if I do, that won't change us.
Are you... really going to transfer away?
It can't be helped... my mom's moving because of her job.
Can't you stay here on your own?
So there's nothing you can do about it?
But still...! We won't change, will we? Even if we're apart...
We'll still always love each other, right?!

File.name: 05-SD-D03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: We'll... always be together, won't we?
You're transferring to another school, aren't you?
B-but still...! Even if I do... even if we're apart... we'll still love each other, won't we?
I will! I'll always love you! No matter how far apart we are!
So... tell me the same thing... tell me that we'll still love each other, even if we're apart.

File.name: 05-SD-D04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Because I love you too, Sekai.

File.name: 05-SD-D05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Is it because... you hate me?
Sekai... if you really loved me, then why didn't you tell me about this earlier?
Because... it was all decided so suddenly.
Liar. Kioura says that it was decided long before the festival.
Well, she's got no reason to lie, does she?
Yes, she does... because ever since the entrance ceremony, she's always...
Do you still remember? Back when you first fell in love with him...
He helped me at the entrance ceremony... and then, the two of us started to talk about him.
Back then, didn't you ever think that I loved him, too?
I've loved him since the first time I met him.
...Anyhow, like she said, if you're just going to transfer away and forget about me, then I...
I didn't say that! There's no way that I'd say that...!
But you're going to transfer away, right?!
She said that she'd take away the loneliness once you were gone... that's all.
That's why it all hasn't really sunk in yet...
So, you'll be going out with her once I transfer away?
Don't! I don't want you to!
You can touch it if you like.
Touch me... the way you always do.
I want you to. Isn't that enough?
Just look... at how good you're making me feel...
When your fingers touch me... I get so wet.
Why don't I make you feel good, too?
Make me feel so good that I'll never forget you, even if we're separated...
There's no point in doing it with someone who's just going to transfer away.
If we can't forget about each other... it'll just make it hard on both of us.
It won't be hard... we'll be happy.

File.name: 05-SD-E00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sekai! Come on, let's go to the after party! We can't get started without the guest of honor!
O-okay, just hold on for a second...
I'll be sure to write... and send you e-mail, too!
I want you to write to me, too.

File.name: 05-SD-E01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: After you so desperately convinced your mother not to go, my mother was chosen instead.
I want to be a good daughter.
When I saw my mother crying, I got the urge to follow her to Paris.
So please, don't let it bother you.
Remember to play nice with Itou.
Haha, I will. When you get back, let's do some indecent things over the phone again.
Yeah. Next time, it'll be something even more incredible.
You'll just have to wait and see.

File.name: 05-SD-F00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well... let's pick up where we left off tomorrow.

File.name: 05-SD-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...On your way back from a date?
Yeah, I'll bet. I saw Makoto waving happily from the train just now, too.
I wonder how you two will be as a couple?
After all... I wasn't able to hold on to him.
If you're going to talk like that, then...
Well, I'll be transferring away... I won't be here anymore, so...
And after I'm gone... rather than having him go out with someone I don't know, it's better if I let you have him, isn't it?
As long as he eventually comes to love you... I'll be happy.
Are you sure this is what you want?
As long as he's happy, I don't care anymore...
Then I'm going to do it with him.
We weren't doing it when this photo was taken, you know.
B-but in the photo in that e-mail, you were naked and...!
I just forced him to strip down and take the photo with me. There's no way that he'd betray you.
But if you're fine with it, then I really will do it with him.
I'll tell him you said it was okay, too.
It's not okay... but it can't be helped... so go ahead.
It's fine... after all, you're in love with him. I don't have the right to stop you.
I really will do it, you know.
When does your transfer paperwork go through?
Then I'm going to do it on the weekend.
On the way home on Friday, we're going to do it at his house.

File.name: 05-SD-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: We're going to do it. We have to.

File.name: 05-SE-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What is it? You look so cheerful.
Could it be that you've gotten a boyfriend?
What kind of boy is he? Introduce him to me! Bring him home!
Listen, now. When I was about your age, I'd long given birth to you.
You grew up way too quickly, Mom.
And you've inherited everything from me.
Everything but that. Like I said, I'm not bringing him home.
What is it? You're not going to tell me that you're pregnant, are you? Not while we're having this conversation...
...Is that boyfriend we were just talking about the father?
I don't know which of them's the father...

File.name: 05-SE-A01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Shh! Please keep quiet, or she'll wake up.
She just took some medicine, so she should be fine with a little rest.
Is she going to be okay?
I see... I was shocked when I heard she collapsed at school.
When I went to the infirmary, they said she'd been taken to the hospital. Did you do the same?
Her mother just came back from work, so she should be all right now.
I know you're worried about Saionji-san, but all we're doing is disturbing her rest.

File.name: 05-SE-A02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: A girl named Katsura-san came to look after you.
A boy came to meet her, and they left together. I wonder if he was her boyfriend?
She sure was pretty. The boy looked like a good match for her, too.
Huh? Isn't he one of your friends, too?
Well, whatever. You take care now, okay? You're responsible for more than one life now, you know.
I hear one of the obstetricians looked you over.
Yeah. They gave me a motherhood handbook and explained all this stuff to me...
Haah... so, you're really going to have the kid?
Well, it's not like you can raise a child.
But like I said, I had my doubts at your age, and I ended up having you anyway. If you're set on it, I won't stop you.
In fact, I'll support you all the way. If you need anything, be sure to let me know.
So, have you told your boyfriend about this?
I see. Good for you, then.
That's totally different from how your father reacted. You must have found a real nice guy.
Okay then, you'd better get some more sleep.
Thanks for everything. I'm going to have a nice, healthy grandchild for you.
A grandchild, huh... wouldn't mind seeing one of those at my age.
My baby's going to be so cute.
Of course. It's your child, and you're mine. Your baby's going to be the cutest one in the world.

File.name: 05-SE-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Did Sekai tell you what she wanted?
No... maybe I was wrong. She didn't like anything we saw.
No, that's okay. You saw how depressed she was today, right? I figured she probably wasn't in the mood.
Though I would like to do something for her...
But I don't want to force a present onto her, so I thought I'd try asking around discreetly.
But no matter what I say, all I get is a half-hearted response. I just don't know what to do.
I know, I shouldn't be relying on you. It's just that you're the only friend I can count on, and you're close to her, too.
You know, sometimes I think that maybe you'd be a better match for her than me...
Well, not that that would ever happen.
Of course. I spent the whole day shopping with Katsura-san, so I can tell. She really loves you.
It's like... no matter what we were looking at, she'd be asking me whether you'd like it.
What kind of guy would even think about another girl when he has one so deeply into him? Man... talk about enviable.
I guess having a girlfriend makes you more confident, so you become even more popular, huh? Damn, I'm jealous!
Haha... well, either way, I envy you.
Anyhow, thanks for the help. I'll ask my sister about the present and work things out on my own.
...No, really. I forgot what I was going to say.
Haha... going senile already? You'd better ask Katsura-san to take care of you, because I ain't going to do it.

File.name: 05-SE-B01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: After class... Sekai suddenly said she wanted to break up.
She just kept saying there was someone else she liked. I just don't get it.... uuh...
Makoto! Did she tell you who she likes?
You're close enough to her to know, right?!
I've always loved Sekai... so I told her I wanted to go out with her.
You're kidding! Aren't you and Katsura-san...?!
I broke up with Kotonoha yesterday.
I'm sorry to do this to you, but...
So that's the kind of guy you are.
I think of you as a friend, too...
You jerk! If that were true, you'd never do something like this!
I wanted to tell you... that I broke up with him.

File.name: 05-SE-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hey. You sure are early today.
Hmn? Not getting enough sleep? ...Or any at all?
I was feeling drowsy, but for some reason, I couldn't fall asleep.
Yeah, well, there's a lot of classes you can't afford to sleep through today.
Yeah, I just went and asked Sekai outright. I told her I wanted to give her a present that she'd like!
You know what she said? 'Anything's fine.'
In other words, she doesn't care what it is, as long as it's from me!
Yeah. My sister says her boyfriend uses that line all the time!
I see. You know, your sister is...
She said she wanted to talk at lunch, too. Maybe she wants to plan for Christmas!
So there you have it. Full steam ahead towards Christmas! Woohoo!
He looked so happy that I couldn't tell him.
But I will! I'm planning to tell him at lunchtime!

File.name: 05-SE-C01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'll tell her at lunchtime, too.

File.name: 05-SE-C03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's just that... I'm not sure what I should be doing anymore...
When two people in love feel the same way about each other, everything will work out fine.
That's not much of a reason.

File.name: 05-SE-C04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You didn't fall asleep, did you?
It's hard to sleep knowing what we're about to do, isn't it?
Come on, come on! If we don't hurry, the cafeteria's going to fill up!

File.name: 05-SE-C05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'll be sure to tell him after class.
Sure. I'm on cleanup duty, so how about after I'm done?
Okay, then. I'll take care of this in no time!

File.name: 05-SE-C06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah. Are you sure you'll be okay getting home at this hour?
Mom has the late shift tonight, so it's no problem.

File.name: 05-SE-C07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I heard you came to see me yesterday. Sorry about that.
It's okay. I was worried about you.
I just worked too hard and slept too little. They say the baby's fine, too.
I made lunch for myself today, with some help from Mom.
It's cold outside, so let's eat in the classroom.
Eheheh... I brought some really fancy stuff.
You know, my mom used to be the manager of a family restaurant, and she used to cook, too...
Ah, have you heard of a restaurant called 'Radish'? That's the place.
Shh! Someone's going to overhear us.
Oh, I know you're curious about it. Eheheh... what did you want to know?

File.name: 05-SE-C08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Eh?! W-what do you mean? It's you.
You mean... you don't believe me? It's your child, Makoto. You're the one I did it with, right?
You came so much that I ended up pregnant. Just like we learned in P.E., right?
Or don't you believe that I'm pregnant? It's true, you know.
Just yesterday, the doctor examined me and gave me a motherhood handbook. I'll show you sometime.
You've got it with you, don't you?
Yeah... but I can't show you here.
O-okay... but you're acting strange, you know?
See? I told you I was pregnant.

File.name: 05-SE-C09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Liar. I heard it all from Kotonoha.
Huh?! But I never told Katsura-san anything.
She said you were almost two months pregnant.
Ah... yeah. She did come with me when I went to see the obstetrician.

File.name: 05-SE-C10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Really? Well, check out this asparagus and bacon roll. It's delicious.
Here, try some. I'll feed you.
Come on, no need to be shy. We're a couple, so it's nothing to be embarrassed about.
Is it... really right to say that we're going out?
I mean... that baby inside you...

File.name: 05-SE-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: If you don't mind, why don't we start eating lunch in my classroom?
After all, I want everyone else to know that you're my boyfriend.
Well... you see, you're actually quite popular!
There are... two or three girls in our class who like the look of you.
I'm not telling! If you knew, you'd start an affair with them.
And besides.... Katou-san and Obuchi-san still don't believe that we're going out together.
Katou-san went to the same school as you, didn't she?
Yeah. We were always in the same class, so we hung out together a lot.
She says she knows you well, and that she can't imagine us going out.
That's why I thought that if we ate in my class, everyone would finally realize the truth.

File.name: 05-SE-D01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So you want to show off.
If you're going to apologize for it, don't bring it up in the first place.

File.name: 05-SE-D02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Why would I want to go to class 4 and eat in front of Katou and her friends?
Ah... well, you wouldn't really be eating with them.
That's not what I'm talking about.
I'd rather not go and make a show of myself.

File.name: 05-SE-D04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's like... you're more irritable. You're not your usual self.
That's not true. You're usually much nicer.
I should get back to class, too...

File.name: 05-SE-E01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You're the only one I ever look at...
I... want to have your baby.

File.name: 05-SE-F00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: He just kept on talking about Christmas. He looked so happy that I just couldn't...
I... tried to tell her, but...
Well, before I could, things got ugly and we ended up fighting.
No! I'm the one who totally failed.
I'll try harder... so you do the same.
Believe me. You're the only one that I love.

File.name: 05-SE-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I was going to call you when I got home.
I wanted to speak with you, too.
All right, you go first, then.
I wanted to apologize for lunchtime.
I said all sorts of things to frustrate you without even considering how you felt.
You were angry, and yet I ended up leaving first on my own. I'm so sorry.
I-it's fine. You don't need to apologize for that.
It was only natural for you to be angry. It was thoughtless of me to try and show you off as my boyfriend...
I said you don't need to apologize!
N-no, I'm happy that you've forgiven me.
U-um... so, what did you want to talk about...?
I wanted to talk... about breaking up.
I... don't think it's working between us.
U-um... did I really make you that angry?
I really am sorry about lunchtime. I won't ask you to eat in my class again.
And if you don't want to have lunch with me at all, I'll eat by myself...
Sorry...? I... I don't understand at all. Why?
Have I been doing something else which upsets you?
If so, I'll stop! I'll change everything about myself which you don't like!
I... don't want us to break up...
It's not that I've come to hate you, but...
I've always been in love with this girl... and now I know that she loves me, too.
...Who is it? This girl that you love.
Why do you want to know?
I won't believe it until I hear it.
Could it be... someone from my class?
A girl from the basketball club, then...
No. Who are you thinking of?
...The girls in our class who are rumored to like you.
If it's not any of them... then who is it?
But... Saionji-san said that she was supporting us...
Sekai and I kept crossing wires. By the time I told her that I loved her, she'd already introduced you to me...
So even if we broke up, you still couldn't go out with her.
Sekai... said that she'd break up with Taisuke, too.
You're kidding. Don't you feel bad for him, knowing how much he's looking forward to Christmas?
And I... don't want to break up with you, either...
I... don't want us to break up...

File.name: 05-SE-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I thought about it, but he would have been shocked to hear that I was going out with you.
He looked so surprised just hearing that we were breaking up. I didn't think I could rub salt into the wound.
Do you think I should have told him?
He asked me who you liked...
I think of him as my friend. I just couldn't hide it from him.
But when I told him, he got really upset. I guess it's pretty much over between us.
No, I told him because I wanted to.
I managed to break up, too.
I see... in that case, we can start going out together.
Yeah. As of now, you're my girlfriend.
What's wrong?! Are you feeling ill?
It's been happening a lot lately.
Shouldn't you get checked out at a hospital?
Yeah. I'm planning on going... but I already know.
Do you remember back before the school festival?
We did it at my house as practice for Katsura-san. A lot.
Yeah. For a while, we were going at it like monkeys, whether we were at home or at school.
Uh-huh... and you came inside me every day, didn't you?
I wasn't even thinking of using a condom, and it felt so much better without one, so...

File.name: 05-SE-H01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Uh-huh. I'll be checking in with the hospital soon, too.
The last time we did it was before the school festival... about three months ago, wasn't it?
What does it matter? The fact is that I really am pregnant.
Yeah. We wouldn't want your stomach to get chilly.

File.name: 05-SE-H02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: This is going to be a problem.
We're students... and only first years, at that. It'll be at least two years before we can graduate and get married.
I'll quit school, have the baby and raise it.
Raise it? You think your mom would let you?!
My mom had me when she was about my age, so she says that if I want to have it, she won't stop me.
I-I'll introduce you to her! All I've told her is that I'm seeing someone at the moment.
Come on, that's enough. Let's go back.
Yeah. It wouldn't be good for the baby to get chilly, right?

File.name: 05-SE-H03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Huh? Aren't you happy for me?
I don't know. It's all so sudden and surprising...
Yeah. I'm going to check at the hospital soon, but there's really no mistaking it.
I've been feeling ill and having these fevers. Mom says it was like that for her, too.
Yeah. Mom had me when she was about my age, so she said she wasn't against it.
Don't you want me to have the baby?
Like I said, it hasn't really sunk in yet. When was the last time we did it?
It was right before the festival, so... two months ago? Three months?
We shouldn't let your stomach get chilly, should we? Let's go back.

File.name: 05-SE-J00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I came by myself, just like you asked. What did you want to talk about?
Makoto? In that case, I should have brought him, too...
Please... stop trying to seduce him!
I heard it all from him. He says he's going to go out with you...
Didn't you say that he and I made a good couple? Why are you doing this?
I also... no, I've loved him a long, long time before you did.
Even so... this is just too cruel!
I love him! I've heard him say that he doesn't hate me, either! If you'd just give up...
Don't you feel sorry for Sawanaga-san?!
He's really in love with you!
If you love Makoto-kun, then why did you go out with Sawanaga-san?!
Because... at the time, I had no choice...
What do you mean, you had no choice?
Well, Makoto was going out with you, so I figured it wouldn't be right for me to keep loving him...
We're still going out! You can't stay in love with him!
But you've already broken up, haven't you?
Is that all you wanted to talk about? If so, I'm leaving. It's cold here, and I don't feel well today.
No. I won't let you go back until you give up on Makoto-kun.
I'm serious! Please, give my Makoto-kun back to me!
Give him back! Please, just give him back!

File.name: 05-SE-L00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Is Sekai really going to be okay?
She'll be fine. The doctor said that she was just tired from a lack of sleep and the additional burden on her body.
I see... she did stay up late last night.
Yesterday, she felt ill and wanted to throw up. That was when I figured she was probably pregnant.
Well, that's how it is. I want to make Sekai and her baby happy, so...
Saionji-san told me at the hospital. She says she's going to have the baby for sure.
Yeah. I'm planning to support her, too...
...I love you, Makoto-kun. I want Saionji-san to give up on you.
I won't say anything to her, but... I really think it would be best for her to have an abortion.
Well, it's certainly going to be tough raising a baby at our age, but even her mom is supportive...
The doctor said that she's been pregnant for less than two months.
You know what that means, don't you?
That's right around the time she started going out with Sawanaga-san.
Did you do it with her while she was going out with Sawanaga-san, too?
Then it should be clear whose baby she's carrying!
If Saionji-san insists on having the baby, it's going to need a father.
It could still be mine... couldn't it?
We did it before the festival... several times. After I told you we should break up.
So it could still be mine, right?
Could you... could you really love a girl who has someone else's baby inside her?
I would gladly have your child, but Saionji-san...

File.name: 05-SE-M00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: That's right after we broke up, when you and Taisuke started going out together.
How could you say that? It's your... it's our baby...
Face it! We didn't do it at all during that time! How could it possibly be our baby?!
It can. It's yours... it's your...
You know... sperm can survive inside the womb for more than a week. So there's still a good chance it could be your baby.
We're not talking about a week here!
Like I said, the doctor said it could be more than a week...
But the odds are that it's Taisuke's, right?
I... think it's your baby. It's yours. I want to believe that it's yours. What's wrong with that...?

File.name: 05-SE-M01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: We can't go on like this.
You're kidding. Just two nights ago, you...
I didn't know that you were pregnant with Taisuke's baby.
You and Taisuke can work out what happens from here on.
No. I don't even like Sawanaga.
You still did it with him, so the least you could do now is talk to him.
No. I want to talk with you.
Well, I don't want to talk with you.

File.name: 05-SE-M02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: No. I'm going to have it.
Do you understand our situation? Just how old do you think we are?! There's no way we could raise it!
You said it was fine just two days ago.
Besides, even if it could be my child, there's no way to be sure. I can't really celebrate something like that.
It is your child. I'm sure of it.

File.name: 05-SE-M03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: No! You're kidding, right?! No! Makoto!

File.name: 05-SE-M04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So, you do care for Taisuke after all.
You love him, so you don't want to abort his baby.
Then you can abort it, can't you?!
You and Taisuke can decide what to do.
I'm saying you should talk to the baby's father. I'm just a third party, and this is none of my business.
A third party...? Don't put it like that.
I said it's none of my business!

File.name: 05-SE-N00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Eheheh... you put out a lot.
You have someone who's entirely devoted to you. Not like Saionji-san, who'll have anyone's baby.
I want you to understand that.
If we do have a baby... I'm sure you'll understand even better.

File.name: 05-SE-O00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's just... I just feel like I haven't had enough sleep.
Well, forget that! Have you heard?
They say... that Sekai quit school.
Right after she quit, Sekai left home and disappeared.
Naturally, she hadn't said a word to me, or to Taisuke or her friends from our class.
She simply ceased to be there.

File.name: 05-SE-P00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's not like it's my baby.

File.name: 05-SE-Q00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Saionji-san. What did you tell her about her baby?
If you really are content with how she is now...
If you can accept her, baby and all...
Then perhaps it was for the best.
But if you really feel that strongly about Saionji-san... then I suppose I have no choice.
I'll... give up on you... and support the two of you.
Sekai is... it's not that I don't like her, but...
I just can't bear the burden of another guy's baby. It's too much for me.
To be honest, I can't keep up with her.
This might sound strange, and it may be really selfish of me, but...

File.name: 05-SE-Q02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Makoto! Sorry to keep you... huh?

File.name: 05-SE-R00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Uh-huh. Hey, are you free tomorrow?
If you are, I'd like you to go somewhere with me.
You mean to see the obstetrician?
When it comes to giving birth, they don't just talk to the mother.
They want to have the father present too, so that they can teach both parents how to prepare. That's why you should...
Y-yes, you are. You're the baby's father. Why would you say something like that?
Things just aren't going to work between us. I'm not sure that I could love you, Taisuke's child and all.
N-no, it's yours. It's your baby...
Katsura-san fed you some kind of story.
H-hey, what do you mean by...?
You're not the sort of person who'd say something like that. Katsura-san's manipulating you!
What are you talking about? It's true that she's spoken to me about this, but...

File.name: 05-SE-S00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: She called me last night and asked me to go to the obstetrician with her.
No. I told her that I couldn't keep up with her anymore.
It wouldn't be right for me to keep stringing her along like this, especially for the baby.
Then she said you were manipulating me. I don't know where she got that from. If she says anything to you later, I'm sorry.
Not at all. I was the one who betrayed her secret.
That's not true. It would have come out sooner or later. You've done nothing wrong.
Besides, haven't I already told you? You're the only one I'm paying attention to, now. You're the only one that I love.
All I'm worried about is that Sekai might blame you for what happened.
Yes... but if it comes to that, it can't be helped.
It's not a matter of who is right...
If someone you love leaves you, and you know someone else is the cause, isn't it natural to hate that other person?
I'm going to apologize as much as I can to Saionji-san. It won't settle things, but it's the least that I can do.
I don't think she'll forgive me...
But even so, if I apologize now, I think the day will come when she'll understand our relationship.
Saionji-san is my dear friend who brought us together...
If, one day, she can find it in herself to forgive me, then I hope we can see each other again and laugh like we used to...
Ahah... haha... haha... hahaha... it's all your fault, Katsura-san. You... and Makoto... haha...

File.name: 05-SG-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You know that I'm going out with him, but you still went and hugged him like you were his lover! He didn't know what to do.
I hugged him because I love him! That was why I kissed him, too! I wanted him to hold me! To love me!
And every time he wanted to do something with me... every time I accepted...
it felt like he loved me, too!
That's why... if there was anything he wanted me to do, I would do it...
I've... always been in love with him.
All this time, I've been holding back, but I've loved him long before you knew him.
And yet... I lied to myself, telling myself that you were already going out with him, and that he was in love with you.
I ignored how I really felt, unable to trust Makoto's feelings. I faltered... I was hurt, crying, lost...
That's why I'm not going to hide it anymore.
I'm not going to just give up anymore.
I'm not going to run away anymore.
I'm... not going to hesitate anymore.
